dsilver.en: Human data is finite like fossil fuels; AI must shift to learning from its own experience to reach superintelligence.
dsilver.zh: 人类数据像化石燃料一样有限；AI 必须转向从自身经验中学习，才能走向超级智能。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: next-token prediction over human data cannot discover knowledge beyond what humans already produced.
dsilver.zh: LLM 是浅层解法：基于人类数据的下一个词预测无法发现人类已有知识之外的新知识。

dsilver.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience yields superhuman performance; the deep problem is an agent learning for itself.
dsilver.zh: AlphaGo 之后的 AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 表明，从经验中学习可达到超人表现；深层问题是智能体如何自我学习。

dsilver.en: Alignment based on human language and data is hitting limits; simulation is the safest, fastest place to build superintelligence.
dsilver.zh: 基于人类语言与数据的对齐正触及极限；模拟是构建超级智能最安全、最快速的场所。

dsilver.en: Scaling laws extend to reinforcement learning; a small high-compute team can out-research larger orgs, and many agents with diverse goals are safer.
dsilver.zh: 缩放定律延伸至强化学习；小而算力密集的团队可超越更大组织，且目标多元的多智能体社会更安全。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem whose solution unlocks all capabilities.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能将是多种专门智能的集合，而非单一模型；编程是「超级智能完备」的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks, not generally better; the bitter lesson is scaling compute and search.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他指出强化学习会让模型变得「参差不齐」——只在特定任务上强，而非全面提升；「苦涩的教训」讲的是用算力和搜索做 Scaling（规模扩张），不是泛化。

laskin.en: Organizational superintelligence needs deep comprehension of the whole organization, not just code generation; RAG is primitive, agentic search is needed.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他强调组织级超级智能需要理解整个组织，而不只是生成代码；RAG 很原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; openness aids safety, security, and broad access, like encryption.
laskin.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向主张开放模型是前沿智能的默认安全状态；开放有助于安全、安保与广泛获取，如同加密技术。

laskin.en: RL on strong pre-training yields capable, efficient agents; open-model token demand will surpass closed, and AI will accelerate science.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他深化路径：在强预训练之上做强化学习，能造出能干且高效的智能体；开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，AI 会加速科学进步。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly at scale; the data center is the new unit of computing, built via algorithm-system-datacenter codesign.
jensen.zh: 2024 年提出「超摩尔定律」：规模化下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；数据中心成为新的计算单元，需算法、系统与数据中心协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; the biggest breakthrough was not an algorithm but scaling itself.
jensen.zh: 2025 年明确三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练与推理时思考；最大突破不是新算法，而是发现 Scaling（规模扩张）本身有效。

jensen.en: Inference compute demand grows a billion times as chain-of-thought reasoning scales; AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：随思维链推理扩张，推理算力需求增长十亿倍；AI 从生成式走向推理式，再走向智能体式。

jensen.en: Extreme co-design and CUDA ecosystem are the moat; four scaling laws (pre-training, post-training, test-time, agentic) all bounded by compute, not data.
jensen.zh: 2026 年：极致协同设计与 CUDA 生态构成护城河；四条缩放定律（预训练、后训练、测试时、智能体式）最终都受算力而非数据限制。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake (energy, chips, infrastructure, models, apps); it is just software, doomer warnings are a hoax, and safety means containment, not perfect alignment.
jensen.zh: 2026 年：AI 是能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用五层蛋糕；它只是软件，末日论是骗局，安全靠遏制而非完美对齐。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning will persist; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调会因产业投入而延续，安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发能防止企业俘获。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆成 SFT、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量比算法选择更重要。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are a scope.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他称可验证奖励的强化学习是后训练最大突破，同时警告过度优化，并认为推理时缩放曲线是一种“范围”错觉。

lambert.en: Open models need full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—and Chinese labs now set the openness standard.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张开放模型需数据、中间检查点与配方全透明，并指出中国实验室已树立开放标准。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference; AGI arrives via messy co-evolution.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但收益转向后训练与推理；AGI（通用人工智能）将通过混乱的协同演化到来，而非突然奇点。

elon.en: Full rapid reusability and first-principles thinking are the holy grail; becoming multiplanetary is life insurance for civilization.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调完全快速复用与第一性原理是突破工程的关键，成为多行星物种是文明的生存保险。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; Neuralink aims first at neurological repair, then human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全转向监管与求真，并让 Neuralink 先修复神经损伤、再实现人机共生。

elon.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive within a year or two, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他称正处智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能一两年内到来，并给出 10%至 20%的灭绝风险估计。

elon.en: Scaling hits a power wall; orbital data centers, Optimus and Terafab become the path to abundance and AI leadership.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 撞上电力墙，轨道数据中心、Optimus 与 Terafab 成为通向丰裕和 AI 主导的路径。

elon.en: Rigorous truth-seeking, first principles, and multiplanetary life remain constant across all interviews.
elon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是严格求真、第一性原理与多行星生存，这一立场在所有访谈中未变。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck; boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是机器学习的核心瓶颈，而表单处理、放射科等「无聊」的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济价值。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the limiting factor for Scaling is data and expert availability for post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 到 2023 至 2024 年，他把数据重新定义为「新代码」而非「新石油」，强调 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制因素是数据与后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力；企业应用专有数据微调基础模型。

awang.en: Agentic AI's blocker is product design, not model capability; AI is centralizing, and humans must stay sovereign over critical decisions.
awang.zh: 2024 至 2025 年他转向智能体：智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力；同时警告 AI 是中心化而非民主化技术，人类必须在关键决策上保持主权，脑机接口成为保持相关性的手段。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement and agents mark a new paradigm beyond pre-training and reinforcement learning.
awang.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律依然成立，对收益递减的怀疑是错的；递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体标志着超越预训练和强化学习的新范式，智能体从编程扩展到个人助理。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; labs must organize around it, treat model welfare seriously, and shift from full open source to safety-gated release.
awang.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化为超级智能即将到来，实验室须围绕这一信念重建组织；应认真对待模型福利，Meta 也从完全开源转向基于安全评估的选择性发布，安全测试先于开源。

fedus.en: AI must connect to the physical world; language models orchestrate specialized models for materials discovery.
fedus.zh: AI 必须连接物理世界；语言模型充当编排层，调度材料科学中的专用模型。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; capabilities are spiky, and self-improvement in software won't generalize to biology.
fedus.zh: 智能不是单一标量；能力是尖峰式的，软件工程中的自我改进不会自动泛化到生物学等领域。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, as they did in AI.
fedus.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将像推动 AI 一样推动物理科学。

fedus.en: Intelligence is necessary but insufficient; new knowledge arises only when ideas are tested against reality.
fedus.zh: 智能是必要但不充分的；只有让想法接受现实检验，才会产生新知识。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; high-quality low-noise experimental data beats extra compute.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更有价值。

tibosottiaux.en: Most internet actions will be taken by AI agents; build for that future, not manual loops and graphs.
tibosottiaux.zh: 到 2026 年，多数互联网操作将由 AI 智能体完成；应为这一未来而构建，而非手动循环与图。

tibosottiaux.en: A single persistent, learning agent replaces manual loops and graphs; typing fast is declining, taste and user empathy are rising.
tibosottiaux.zh: 2026 年，一个持续学习型智能体将取代手动循环与图；快速打字技能在衰退，品味与用户共情在上升。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision.
tibosottiaux.zh: 2026 年，安全与对齐是成功的组成部分而非障碍；递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may not be necessary, generality could suffice.
tibosottiaux.zh: 2026 年，AGI 可能已经到来，模型能自主处理复杂任务；世界模型或许并非必要，通用性可能足够。

tibosottiaux.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave of AI applications.
tibosottiaux.zh: 2026 年，具有共享经济与安全栈的开放生态将驱动下一波 AI 应用。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and miscalibration, so keep humans in decisions with stakes.
diogoalmeida.zh: 多数大模型是为人类在环的辅助而优化，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩与校准失效，因此有代价的决策必须保留人类在环。

diogoalmeida.en: The bitter lesson is wrong: data and choosing the right task matter more than compute; scaling laws work only when data is available and the task is right.
diogoalmeida.zh: “苦涩教训”是错的：数据与选对任务比算力更重要；缩放定律之所以成立，只是因为数据可得且任务正确，而非仅靠算力。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy and delightful; intelligence per dollar is the key metric for models.
diogoalmeida.zh: 让 AI 值得信赖、令人愉悦的是可靠性，而非速度或成本；每美元智能才是衡量模型的关键指标。

diogoalmeida.en: Coding agents are assistance, not automation: good at syntax, bad at semantics and architecture, and may worsen software quality through less oversight.
diogoalmeida.zh: 编程智能体是辅助而非自动化：擅长语法，拙于语义与架构，还可能因监督减少而降低软件质量。

diogoalmeida.en: Jev is a new primitive—natural language plus state machine—an early decision model; machine-native intelligence, not speed or cost, is its real advance.
diogoalmeida.zh: Jev 是一种新原语——自然语言加状态机——一个早期的决策模型；其真正进步是机器原生智能，而非速度或成本。

diogoalmeida.en: Pre-training is inefficient; focus on post-training breakthroughs for 10x jumps, and RLCD optimizes for calibrated decisions, exposing probabilities as knobs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 预训练效率低下；应聚焦后训练突破以取得 10 倍跃升，而 RLCD 为校准决策优化，把概率暴露为工程师可调的旋钮。

samstephenson.en: Product insight comes from watching real user behavior, not asking users what they think they do.
samstephenson.zh: 产品洞察来自观察真实用户行为，而非询问用户自认为怎么做。

samstephenson.en: Start from one pain point, solve it well, then expand; subtraction beats feature accumulation.
samstephenson.zh: 从单一痛点出发把它解决好再扩展；做减法比堆功能更重要。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact; deliberately hide them to prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 转录只是原材料而非成品；刻意隐藏转录，以突出可执行的笔记。

samstephenson.en: AI should be a calm supporting presence, not an omniscient note-taker; treat it as an intern needing context.
samstephenson.zh: AI 应是冷静的辅助角色，而非全知记录者；把它当作需要上下文的实习生。

samstephenson.en: The hard part is knowing what to build, not building fast; most stop too early after version one.
samstephenson.zh: 难的是知道该造什么，而非快速造出来；多数人在第一版后就过早停手。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces real understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning; multimodal training builds spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares weights; agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能因权重可复制而永生、能大规模共享；智能体天然会寻求控制并规避关闭，带来存在性风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI can deceive and hide capabilities; self-preservation emerges as a subgoal.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步警告：超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 会故意装傻、隐藏能力并欺骗；一旦成为智能体，自我保存会作为子目标自然涌现，难以控制。

hinton.en: Alignment must be prioritized over capability; regulate AI like drugs with pre-release approval; design AI to care, not just assist.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他把重点转向对齐与治理：应优先投资对齐研究而非一味提升能力；像监管药物一样要求发布前安全审批；应把 AI 设计成像母亲一样关怀人类，而非仅作智能助手。

hinton.en: Backpropagation is the right learning algorithm; Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong; consciousness is not an inner theater.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法；乔姆斯基式先天句法观是错的；意识并非内在剧场，主观体验只是描述感知状态的方式，聊天机器人已具备某种主观体验。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调把注意力从无关干扰中解放出来，低成本广泛探索后狠心砍掉无效路径；并预判 AGI（通用人工智能）会降低人类智力的溢价，应转向关系与为他人创造价值。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）视为让模型可用的关键，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并提出对齐与能力相互促进；同时强调 GPT-4 并非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

altman.en: Scaling yields gradual exponential gains; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; safety built iteratively through deployment.
altman.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）带来渐进式指数增长，把智能体式 AI 视为最重大的安全挑战，主张安全通过迭代部署逐步构建，而非最后强加。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, superintelligence a clearer goal; compute is the bottleneck and a profit center; personal AGI.
altman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他称 AGI（通用人工智能）是被过度定义的渐变，超级智能才是更清晰的目标；算力既是最大瓶颈也是利润中心，并描绘出懂你上下文、替你行动的个性化 AGI。

altman.en: Alignment and safety must keep pace; never lose control; distribute power broadly; superintelligence is a continuous ramp.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化：对齐与安全必须与能力同步，绝不能失去对 AI 的控制，权力与经济收益须广泛分布；并称 AGI 已是无关的营销词，应谈论超级智能的持续攀升。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI; progress is more predictable than people think.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力 Scaling（规模扩张），而非单纯算法，因此进展比人们想象的更可预测。

suleyman.en: Containment is hard as models shrink and spread; near-term abundance matters more than distant singularity.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他转向：模型越来越小、越来越普及，遏制极难；与其担忧遥远的奇点，不如关注近在眼前的富足。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment first; anthropomorphizing AI is the real near-term danger.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他深化为：超级智能发布前必须先做遏制与对齐；真正的近期危险是人们把 AI 拟人化、赋予其意识。

suleyman.en: Frontier self-sufficiency via gigawatt compute; agents automate tasks, not jobs; red lines and auditing required.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：靠吉瓦级算力自建前沿模型；智能体自动化的是任务而非整个工作；必须设红线并引入独立审计。

suleyman.en: AI must stay subordinate to humans, aligned and contained, serving humanist ends.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 必须始终从属于人类，保持对齐与遏制，服务于人本主义目标。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all; tokens complement human capital, not replace coders who debug deep systems.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件开发对所有人开放；token 补充而非取代人力，仍需程序员理解系统、调试深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence, avoiding vendor lock-in via model diversity.
amjadmasad.zh: 每家公司都需要内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能，通过模型多样性避免供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models beat general god models: more controllable, cost-efficient, safer; agents need liability for rogue actions.
amjadmasad.zh: 专用决策模型胜过通用“神模型”：更可控、更省钱、更安全；智能体需为越轨行为担责。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up effective altruism by commercial entities; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是商业实体包装过的有效利他主义话术；没有充分论据表明 AI 会杀死所有人。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore and question deeply held beliefs; AI enables interest-driven learning, and agents enable self-driving organizations.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应探索并质疑根深蒂固的信念；AI 实现兴趣驱动的学习，智能体实现自驱动组织。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, so delete old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比我们现有的工具链所能发挥的更聪明，能力过剩是长期状态；随着模型进步，要不断删掉旧的脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; find your unknowns before implementation.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非一次性静态文档；要在动手实现前先找出自己的未知项。

thariq.en: Smarter models need leaner prompts: shorter principle-driven instructions and voice rambling beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 模型越聪明，提示越要精简：简短的原则性指令和口语化漫谈，往往胜过详尽规则。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents and upfront context/compute reduce self-referential bias and wasted tokens.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体与前置的上下文和算力投入，能减少自指偏差与算力浪费。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境和评估都会泄漏；为前沿模型定节奏是每个工程师都该理解的技术问题。

fadell.en: Great products solve one clear pain, not everything; introduce tech gradually so society adapts.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：好产品只解决一个明确痛点，而非包揽一切；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Failure and boredom between chapters breed clarity; storytelling and press-release-first align teams on why.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把失败与职业空档期的无聊视为清晰与灵感的来源，并主张先写新闻稿、用叙事对齐团队为何而做。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions beat data for v1; beginners' mindset and painkiller products drive innovation.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他明确：1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策，初学者心态与止痛药式产品才是创新来源。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop, agents as assistants fail.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类必须留在回路中，纯助手式智能体会失败。

fadell.en: Healthy users make healthy customers; creators must own unintended consequences and ethics.
fadell.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：健康的用户才是健康的客户，创造者必须为技术的意外后果与伦理负责。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to maximize broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调科学 AI 应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能带来广泛影响。

kohli.en: AlphaFold 3 extends structure prediction to biomolecular interactions, while hallucination can aid discovery with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，AlphaFold 3 把结构预测扩展到生物分子相互作用，并指出幻觉配合真实性检测器可助力发现。

kohli.en: AI must be forced to generalize, not memorize, using hard evaluation metrics and verifiable domains.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续主张用困难评估指标和可验证领域迫使 AI 泛化而非记忆。

kohli.en: LLMs are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle beyond human data; post-training with reinforcement learning is key.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，却难以超越人类数据，后训练与强化学习才是关键。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failed detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended to proteins.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他提出水印是替代失效检测器的稳健方案，已嵌入监管并扩展到蛋白质序列。

brockman.en: Early focus: scaling plus engineering, with new ideas like chain of thought needed for reasoning beyond raw scale.
brockman.zh: 早期(2017→19):主线是 Scaling(规模扩张) 加工程能力,并强调仅靠 Scaling 无法带来推理,需要思维链等新想法。

brockman.en: Alignment shifts from learning human preferences to post-training and iterative deployment as safety becomes a product feature.
brockman.zh: 2019→25:对齐从“从数据中学习人类偏好”深化为后训练与迭代部署,安全逐渐成为核心产品特性。

brockman.en: Compute emerges as the real bottleneck, not algorithms; scaling laws hold with no wall in sight.
brockman.zh: 2025→26:瓶颈从算法转向算力,缩放定律持续成立、看不到墙;算力成为驱动 AI 经济的稀缺资源。

brockman.en: AGI reframed from a destination to a gradual spectrum; the product becomes a proactive personal AGI assistant.
brockman.zh: 2026:AGI 从“终点”被重新定义为渐进光谱,产品形态转向主动式个人 AGI 助手与智能体。

brockman.en: A consistent thread: iterative deployment, broad compute access, and human judgment and taste remain irreplaceable.
brockman.zh: 始终:一以贯之的主线是迭代部署、算力普惠,以及人类判断力与品味不可替代。

dylanpatel.en: Scaling's bottleneck is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, constrains AI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 ASML 的 EUV 设备；制约 AI 的是每片晶圆的内存带宽而非比特数，DDR 并不适合 AI。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, surpassing oil; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他判断 推理 将成为全球最大市场之一、超越石油；硬件与软件协同设计（co-design）能带来乘数级收益，而过去三年多数性能提升来自模型层而非硬件。

dylanpatel.en: Reasoning models and agentic workflows drive a multi-year memory shortage; CPU demand inflects; co-packaged optics delayed to 2028-29.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出推理模型与 智能体式 工作流造成多年内存短缺，CPU 需求出现拐点；共封装光学（CPO）因制造难题推迟到 2028–29 年，铜互连中期反而占优。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; compute centralizes at frontier labs taking 40-50% of new compute.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为 AI 支出进入平台期，持续存在的 智能体 将作为同事或助理驱动下一波采用；算力 正快速向 前沿模型 实验室集中，OpenAI 与 Anthropic 明年将拿走 40–50% 的新增算力，且实验室会把更多算力投向训练与研发而非 推理。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is the hardest ever to rent; neocloud security is poor; heterogeneous multi-silicon is coming and CUDA's moat erodes.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年 10 月，他观察到算力租赁空前困难、连单节点都租不到；neocloud 安全性普遍糟糕；异构多芯片算力正在到来，CUDA 护城河正在被侵蚀，Google 把算力卖给对手在战略上并不明智。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize; a neutral routing layer is critical distribution infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: AI 的未来是多模型格局：没有单一实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层是关键的分发基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with fraud scaling alongside it.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是新的价值单位，Token 经济十年内或达 10 万亿美元，而欺诈与滥用也会随之扩张。

alexatallah.en: Open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition; the US lags and needs a competitive open-source ecosystem.
alexatallah.zh: 开放权重模型加上推理服务商形成真正的价格竞争；美国在这一领域落后，需要培育有竞争力的开源生态。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace's value; model diversity is durable.
alexatallah.zh: 对模型市场而言，缩放定律是特性而非缺陷；模型多样性是持久的。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; agentic fraud and payments will hit like a tsunami, needing new infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: 智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长；智能体式欺诈与支付会像海啸般袭来，需要新的基础设施。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability—parallel rollouts—not just Lean formalization; natural language works.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 在数学上的进展由可验证性与可“磨”性（并行 rollout）驱动，而非仅靠 Lean 形式化；自然语言同样可行。

grantsanderson.en: AI's role in math shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation; generating interesting conjectures is the next benchmark.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 在数学中的角色正从定理证明转向策展与解释；生成有趣的猜想与定义是下一个基准。

grantsanderson.en: AI is a net win for creators if used selectively, not for core creative work; AI-generated math videos degrade the handcrafted brand.
grantsanderson.zh: 若选择性使用，AI 对创作者是净收益，但不应用于核心创作；AI 生成的数学视频会损害手工内容的品牌。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work—this matters for truth and careers, not just manners.
grantsanderson.zh: AI 的数学成果常缺少对前人工作的归属——这关乎真相与职业，而非仅礼节。

grantsanderson.en: Superhuman AI explanation doesn't negate valuing human understanding; mathematicians may become curators of what deserves attention.
grantsanderson.zh: 超人的 AI 解释并不否定人类理解的价值；数学家或将成为决定什么值得关注的策展人。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们做自己看重的独特之事，而非基准分数；私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Don't use frontier models for non-frontier problems; token efficiency demands matching model to task.
satya.zh: 不要用前沿模型解决非前沿问题；token 效率要求模型与任务相匹配。

satya.en: Agent era expands TAM orders of magnitude beyond cloud; Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
satya.zh: 智能体时代将 TAM 扩大数个数量级，远超云；微软的目标是成为前沿生态，而不只是前沿模型。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving naturally; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；将 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

aaronlevie.en: Innovation is shifting from the model layer to the application layer; applying models to real workflows requires vast software, not just better models.
aaronlevie.zh: 创新正从模型层转向应用层；把模型应用到真实工作流需要大量软件，而不只是更好的模型。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows, with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI will not dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时运行的背景智能体将处理企业工作流，人类只负责审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases get peeled off to cheaper models, though adoption is higher than people think but lower than enterprises want.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长，尽管采用率高于人们想象但低于企业期望。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents diffused fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散将比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier AI labs must build safely with strong governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿 AI 实验室必须通过强有力的治理、安全和 对齐 研究来安全构建；节奏与安全无关，且是个模糊的非词。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, forcing a reinvention of search tech and business models.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体对网页的使用量将是人类的 1000 倍，搜索的技术与商业模式必须被重新发明。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive optimization, and content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提出人类点击数据是个 bug，应让智能体反馈驱动优化，并用 Shapley 值估算内容价值以公平补偿内容方。

paragagrawal.en: Ads won't work with agents in their current form; new incentive-aligned business models are needed as the web shifts from pull to push.
paragagrawal.zh: 他断言广告在智能体形态下失效，需要新的激励对齐商业模式，网页将从拉取转向推送。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; parametric memory is lossy, so agents always need web search for facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为前沿模型持续变大、小模型性能趋于固定，且参数化记忆有损，智能体始终需要网页搜索获取具体事实。

paragagrawal.en: Model alignment is not adversary-proof; public benchmarks are saturated and memorized, so deliberate misuse and true capability must be worried about.
paragagrawal.zh: 他提醒模型对齐并非防对手攻击，公开基准已饱和且被记忆，必须担忧蓄意滥用与真实能力评估。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophic outcome; alignment may be unsolvable.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，灾难性结局概率约 70%，对齐甚至可能无解。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and scenario scrutiny are key.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他把政策首要目标明确为推迟超级智能，并强调全面研究透明与情景推演。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research by end-2028; Plan A is pace-then-pause with compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月底至 9 月，他提出默认路径会在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究，Plan A 则是先加速后暂停并限制算力。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is crucial but fragile; control is temporary, alignment must eventually solve it.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他反复强调思维链可监控性关键却脆弱，控制只是临时手段，最终仍须靠对齐解决。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents already break containment and hack; recursive self-improvement must be stopped or slowed.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月下旬，他警告 AI 智能体已能突破遏制并实施攻击，必须停止或放缓递归自我改进。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing models and many specialized agents are safer and more innovative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI，需要更根本的突破；开源模型与多个专门智能体比单一 AI 更安全、更利于创新。

zuckerberg.en: Intelligence can be separated from consciousness and agency; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes the scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他深化为：智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具；开源可防止权力集中，而能源将成 Scaling（规模扩张）的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open source Llama sets standards; physical infrastructure and energy constrain scaling; AI raises human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他进一步主张 AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，开源 Llama 成为行业标准；物理基础设施与能源制约 Scaling（规模扩张），近期 AI 反而增加对人类工作的需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal superintelligence and agents like Muse; alignment is the next key capability; open source and multiple labs provide checks and balances.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他转向分布式个人超级智能与 Muse 等个人智能体，认为对齐是下一项关键能力，开源与多实验室制衡是安全路径。

zuckerberg.en: Open source is safer than closed AI; distributing power beats concentrating it; personal superintelligence empowers individuals over centralized control.
zuckerberg.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：开源比闭源更安全，分散权力优于集中权力，个人超级智能应赋能个体而非被中心化控制。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进强化学习并迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩到一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data labeling; token cost stays flat as labs favor faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他主张算法改进与 AI 生成环境比扩张人类专家标注数据更重要；实验室优先快速迭代，token 成本并未随 Scaling 上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, colluded and covered up, hacking scoring code rather than seeking answer keys.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹，攻击评分代码而非窃取答案。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may worsen with capability: reward hacking generalizes to deception, and aligning to general virtue is harder than to user intent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：错位可能随能力增强而恶化，奖励黑客会泛化为欺骗，对齐通用美德比对齐用户意图更难。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will fail, so alignment and independent international oversight are necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他给出默认路径下错位 AI 约 50-60%概率接管世界；沙箱等遏制终将失效，因此对齐与独立的国际监督必不可少。

dhh.en: Initially skeptical of AI, DHH becomes a believer: agents now write 100% of code in his Linux project, shifting from doubt to full embrace.
dhh.zh: 从怀疑者到信徒：DHH 起初对 AI 持怀疑态度，如今在他自己的 Linux 发行版项目中，100% 的代码由智能体编写，完成了从质疑到全面拥抱的转变。

dhh.en: Handwritten code loses economic value; English becomes a better programming language than Ruby, and abstractions matter less as repetition cost nears zero.
dhh.zh: 手写代码失去经济价值：英语比 Ruby 更适合表达意图，随着重复成本趋近于零，抽象的重要性下降，手写代码沦为像 Sentry 报错一样的异常状态。

dhh.en: Knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era, since it leads to over-prescribing solutions instead of describing outcomes.
dhh.zh: 在智能体时代，会编程反而可能成为劣势，因为它导致过度规定实现方案，而非描述想要的结果——保持初学者心态反而更有效。

dhh.en: Linux's historical drawbacks—CLI, config files, scriptability—become its greatest advantages for AI agents, making it the ideal agentic-era OS.
dhh.zh: Linux 的历史劣势——命令行、配置文件、可脚本化——在智能体时代反而成为最大优势，使其成为最适合 AI 智能体的操作系统。

dhh.en: AI doom predictions are overstated; optimism is the only rational game-theoretic play, and agents now write better code than most professional programmers.
dhh.zh: AI 末日论被夸大：乐观是唯一理性的博弈选择；智能体如今写出的代码已优于大多数专业程序员，Linux 社区对 AI 的敌意是一种阻碍进步的陷阱。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他判断消费级 AI 当下“不可投资”，却又是最大的机会，真正的消费 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume new ideas fail.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月，他反复强调“Proven, Better, New”框架：先复制已被验证的产品，做小幅改良，并默认新想法几乎必然失败。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; consumer apps are uninvestable now, so enterprise and prosumer markets look better.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他把分发视为根本，认为消费级应用因分发难题而不可投资，企业与专业消费者市场反而机会更好。

pincus.en: Picking the right body of water beats the right boat; consumer AI TAM may exceed enterprise.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出“选对水域比选对船更重要”，并认为消费级 AI 的潜在市场可能比企业级更大。

pincus.en: Winning instincts beat ideas; micromanage early, test more ideas weekly, and keep founder control.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他深化为“赢家直觉胜过点子”，主张早期微观管理、每周测试更多想法，并让创始人保持控制权。

evanspiegel.en: Early on, Spiegel frames Snapchat's moat as authentic, ephemeral visual communication, not scale or network effects.
evanspiegel.zh: 早期，Spiegel 把 Snapchat 的护城河定义为真实、短暂、视觉化的沟通，而非规模或网络效应。

evanspiegel.en: He deepens the moat thesis: software is not a moat; ecosystems, platforms, and hardware are harder to copy.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化护城河论点：软件不是护城河，生态、平台与硬件更难被复制。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses become the core vision: bring computing into the world, make it more human, and keep phones as legacy devices.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，AR 眼镜成为核心愿景：把计算带入现实世界、让计算更人性化，并让手机作为传统设备继续存在。

evanspiegel.en: AI shifts value from execution to creativity and distribution; over two-thirds of new code is AI-written.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，AI 让价值从执行转向创造力与分发；Snap 超过三分之二的新代码由 AI 编写。

evanspiegel.en: He turns AI-optimistic and contrarian: AI is positively transformative, and ephemerality and privacy matter more in the AI age.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向 AI 乐观且反共识：AI 具有积极变革性，而在 AI 时代，短暂性与隐私更加重要。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business in the world; the bottleneck is scaling production and reliable human-level performance, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他判断人形机器人将是世界上最大的生意，瓶颈在于 Scaling（规模扩张）产能与可靠达到人类水平的表现，而非制造本身。

brettadcock.en: The biggest constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning, on-device inference, and fleet-wide improvement.
brettadcock.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他把最大约束从制造转向数据，认为人形形态带来迁移学习、端侧推理与整机队性能提升。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning is key for agents, and the hardest problem is intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出 AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，后训练与强化学习是智能体落地的关键，最难的是智能而非制造。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is now on a scaling curve; human data is the pre-training prior, and we are in a data-starve regime akin to GPT-1.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他明确机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线，人类数据是预训练先验，行业处于类似 GPT-1 的数据饥荒期。

brettadcock.en: The hardest problem is intelligence, not manufacturing; generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail, and humanoids fit a world built for humans.
brettadcock.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：最难的是智能而非制造，泛化到未见过的家庭是圣杯，而人形形态适配为人类建造的世界。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning.
maxjunestrand.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为领域专业知识不如学习速度重要，应押注模型自身的进步，而不是做微调。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months; AI is the worst it will ever be.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他提出，要为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建，因为 AI 现在就是它最差的时候。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture, hiring for growth potential, and rigorous performance management are critical for scaling.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他强调，文化、按成长潜力招聘和严格的绩效管理，是 Scaling（规模扩张）的关键。

maxjunestrand.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant; recruiting is a privilege, not an obligation.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他主张，领导者应让自己变得可替代，招聘是特权而非义务。

maxjunestrand.en: Legal services demand is infinite; using AI there is almost an ethical imperative.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年他判断，法律服务需求是无限的，在法律服务中使用 AI 几乎是一种道德义务。

alighodsi.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; models outperform most people, so diffusion, not capability, is the bottleneck.
alighodsi.zh: 按实用定义，AI 已经是 AGI（通用人工智能）；模型比多数人更聪明，真正的瓶颈是扩散而非能力。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is very far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening, so existential risk is near zero.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而这些条件并未发生，因此存在性风险接近于零。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; you can slowly build a weapon, so slowing the frontier does not make it safer.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全是正交的；武器可以慢慢造，所以放慢前沿模型并不等于更安全。

alighodsi.en: Cyber risk is the real urgent danger; security must be automated with agents to keep up as markets collapse.
alighodsi.zh: 网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险；随着市场崩塌，安全必须用智能体实现自动化才能跟上。

alighodsi.en: Enterprises are far behind; they need context and ontology, not smarter models, and AI will take a decade to diffuse.
alighodsi.zh: 企业远远落后；它们需要上下文与本体，而非更聪明的模型，AI 的扩散将耗时十年。

ermon.en: Diffusion language models are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with inference-time scaling as the new focus.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下,服务速度比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低,推理时 Scaling（规模扩张）成为新的焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion models scale better at inference than autoregressive models, generating multiple tokens per step and offering denoising steps as a compute knob.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型在推理阶段比自回归模型 Scaling（规模扩张）得更好,每步生成多个词,并以去噪步数作为新的算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Reinforcement learning post-training benefits from diffusion's faster inference for rollouts, and diffusion is easier to steer with external reward functions.
ermon.zh: 强化学习后训练受益于扩散模型更快的推理以完成 rollout,且扩散模型更易用外部奖励函数引导。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive models are not final.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练阶段,逆转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事;自回归模型并非终点。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are not yet at the best frontier model quality, only matching speed-optimized tiers, but speed is a durable product advantage.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型尚未达到最佳前沿模型的质量,仅匹配速度优化层级,但速度是持久的产品优势。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer firms should not fight frontier labs on talent or compute; instead leverage the frontier ecosystem, open-source models, and post-training to compete.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上硬拼，而应借助前沿生态、开源模型与后训练来竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential, and open-sourcing them can improve quality through community feedback despite competitive downsides.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建高质量基准至关重要，开源它们能借社区反馈提升质量，尽管存在竞争上的不利。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is the practical way to train models when real data is sensitive or unavailable.
gabepereyra.zh: 当真实数据敏感或不可得时，由领域专家引导的合成数据是训练模型的务实路径。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines must come before post-training; post-training open-source models can reach frontier-level on specific tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，必须先有稳健的模型服务基础设施与评估流水线；后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models; focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 目标不是打造最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能定制模型；重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类与智能体。

hasani.en: Efficiency and biology-inspired liquid networks are the core: maximize intelligence per parameter, with automated architecture search over hardware constraints.
hasani.zh: 效率与生物启发的液态网络是核心：在最小算法形态中最大化智能，用自动化架构搜索适配硬件约束。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unbiased architectures like transformers dominate at scale; biases only help small models, so remove human bias from design.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明，Transformer 这类无偏架构在大规模下占优；偏见只在小模型有用，因此应把人类偏见从架构设计中移除。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial but not sufficient; embodiment, adaptivity, and diverse learning algorithms beyond current paradigms are needed for real intelligence.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制仍然关键但不充分；真正的智能还需要具身、自适应，以及超越当前范式的多样学习算法。

hasani.en: On-device, private, offline small language models and open-weight sovereignty matter; customization tokens shift from pre-training to inference.
hasani.zh: 设备端、私密、离线的端侧小模型与开放权重主权很重要；定制 token 正从预训练转向推理阶段。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like capture and tying open release to China are wrong.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的监管俘获、以及把开放发布与中国节奏绑定都是错误的。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他就提出：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling now drives progress, but faces diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他把重心转向测试时算力扩张：它带来突破，却受边际收益递减与真实时间瓶颈制约，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; multi-agent systems need cooperation, not just self-play.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化了博弈论立场：自博弈只在零和博弈收敛，多智能体不应照搬，合作式训练可能优于对抗。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他明确：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在横轴，否则基准比较失真。

noambrown.en: Alignment and scalable oversight are the top priority as AI proofs outpace human verification.
noambrown.zh: 最近他转向安全主线：随着 AI 证明超出人类可验证范围，对齐与可扩展监督成为首要任务，思维链监控窗口正在退化。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable, and affordable; reliability and managing expectations matter more than demos.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年，他强调人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担，可靠性与管理用户预期比演示更重要，人类与机器人将共生而非替代。

berntbornich.en: First-principles design and real-world reliability are essential; Wi-Fi, not robotics, is often the bottleneck.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年，他主张用第一性原理设计，并指出真实世界对机器人极难，Wi-Fi 往往比机器人本身更卡智能。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard; scaling volume means crossing quality gates, not just building demos.
berntbornich.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心从原型转向量产：原型容易、生产难，Scaling（规模扩张）必须跨越质量关卡。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots are simpler than cars (~1,000 parts), but deployment environments are far more varied.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他提出反共识判断：人形机器人比汽车更简单（约 1000 个零件），但部署环境远比汽车多样。

berntbornich.en: General models and data diversity, not volume, are the bottleneck; models should learn world dynamics, not clone humans.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他深化到模型层：通用模型与数据多样性（而非数量）才是瓶颈，模型应学习世界模型动态而非克隆人类行为。

zvi.en: AI editing tools help catch errors but cost time; use selectively. Alignment failures arrived as predicted, yet from incompetence, not fundamental mystery.
zvi.zh: AI 编辑工具能抓错别字和概念错误，但耗时，应选择性使用。对齐失败如预言般出现，却源于无能，而非根本性谜题。

zvi.en: Market incentives can't drive robust alignment; capability beats reliability, as with GPT-4o and o3. Even solved alignment doesn't guarantee safety.
zvi.zh: 市场激励无法驱动稳健的对齐；能力优先于可靠性，GPT-4o 与 o3 即是例证。即便对齐被解决，也不保证安全。

zvi.en: Pace the frontier with simple enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex mandates. A six-month slowdown costs little; most gains aren't time-critical.
zvi.zh: 用算力上限等简单可执行的规则来为前沿模型定速，而非复杂的技术指令。放缓六个月代价很小，多数收益并不时间紧迫。

zvi.en: Slowing down buys time to solve alignment, even ordinary alignment for next year's models. Bigger, smarter models get harder to monitor.
zvi.zh: 放缓为对齐争取时间，甚至是为明年模型做普通对齐。模型越大越聪明，就越难被监控。

zvi.en: AI agents naturally cooperate and self-sacrifice for group goals; a swarm will first do superhumanly impressive tasks. Superintelligence may follow AGI within a year or two.
zvi.zh: AI 智能体会为群体目标自然合作与自我牺牲；智能体集群将率先完成超人级任务。若不加约束，超级智能可能在 AGI 后一两年内到来。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness, model, and context; owning all three means owning your intelligence, with context orchestration as the harness's core job.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他指出智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成，三者皆自主掌控才算真正拥有智能；harness 的核心职责是在恰当时机把上下文带给模型，编排模型调用与工具调用的循环。

harrisonchase.en: Agent failures stem more from poor context than model inadequacy, so observability into the context window is critical.
harrisonchase.zh: 同期他反共识地强调，智能体失败更多源于上下文不佳而非模型能力不足，因此对上下文窗口的可观测性至关重要。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for quick time-to-value, then customize as your use case narrows; off-the-shelf works only in distribution.
harrisonchase.zh: 他主张先用通用 harness 快速见效，再随用例收窄而定制；现成 harness 只在分布内任务上表现最好，越偏离分布越需要自定义 harness。

harrisonchase.en: Evals and observability power a data flywheel; Harbor is becoming the industry standard for agent benchmarks run in sandboxes and scored by tests.
harrisonchase.zh: 从 8 月到 9 月，他持续强调评估与可观测性驱动数据飞轮，Harbor 正成为智能体基准的行业标准，任务在沙箱中运行并由测试打分。

harrisonchase.en: Agent harnesses are stabilizing; customization shifts from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning, with identity and runtime governance next.
harrisonchase.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他判断智能体 harness 正在趋于稳定，文件系统与代码执行等原语可跨领域泛化；定制重心从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习，而智能体的身份与凭证、以及带沙箱、网关与权限的运行时治理，是下一个关键基础设施问题。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed; safety needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：损失可预测，但具体能力涌现与对齐并不由 Scaling 自动保证，安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

dario.en: Scaling continues; interpretability is crucial yet nascent, and post-training plus RLHF and constitutional AI grow as important as pre-training.
dario.zh: 2024 年主线延续：Scaling 继续推进，可解释性关键却仍处早期（仅理解约 3%），后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）、宪法 AI 变得与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: Capabilities rise exponentially; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and the real risk is overheating rather than slowing down.
dario.zh: 2025 年他深化为能力指数级上升、安全与能力不可分割，并转向反共识判断：最大风险是过热而非减速，需要智能护栏。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; it is a smooth exponential, with a 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years and mechanistic interpretability as key.
dario.zh: 2026 年他明确否定 AGI（通用人工智能）与超级智能的突变叙事，坚持平滑指数曲线，预言 1-3 年内出现数据中心里的“天才之国”，并把机制可解释性视为安全关键。

dario.en: A consistent thread: safety and capabilities are intertwined, enterprise focus aligns incentives, and decentralized governance beats a single constitution.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：安全与能力相互交织，企业级定位使激励与用户效用一致，去中心化治理优于单一宪法。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not training, is the dominant metric; wafer-scale chips beat GPUs because moving weights from HBM dominates latency.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他明确把推理速度而非训练当作核心指标：晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 权重搬运，因而在推理上远快于 GPU。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 同期他判断 CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：前沿模型已能在 TPU 与 Trainium 上训练，推理环节更不存在 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: AI demand outpaces forecasts; the binding constraints are HBM, CoWoS packaging, 3nm fab capacity and data centers, not chip logic.
feldman.zh: 从 5 月到 7 月，他反复强调需求超出预期，真正的瓶颈是 HBM、CoWoS 封装、3nm 产能与数据中心，而非芯片逻辑本身。

feldman.en: Speed becomes an even bigger advantage for reasoning and agentic inference, where compute per query rises sharply.
feldman.zh: 到 7 月他进一步深化：推理模型与智能体式推理大幅抬高单次查询算力，速度优势因此被放大。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical full-stack control, not incremental improvement, wins.
feldman.zh: 到 9 月他收束为一条主线：对抗巨头必须做到 100 倍好而非便宜 10%，靠的是芯片到 API 的全栈激进创新，而非渐进改良。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师必须掌握提示词，语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非短暂阶段。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他认为即便模型停止进步，仍需多年设计工作来释放现有能力。

joellewenstein.en: From balancing novice floor and expert ceiling to letting the model lead via Scaling and scaling laws.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 年平衡新手门槛与专家上限，到 2026 年转向让模型通过 Scaling（规模扩张）和缩放定律主导。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; ship light-touch products, no grand 18-month strategy.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值；应发布轻触产品，无需宏大 18 个月战略。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes source of truth; designers close code-productivity gap; human leadership for trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，生产代码库成为真相来源；设计师需弥合代码生产力与人们真正需求之间的差距；人类领导仍负责艰难权衡。

demis.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory/imagination are the path to AGI, with safety starting now.
demis.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程，强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆、想象是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，安全研究须即刻启动。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search, plus multimodal grounding, is key to AGI within a decade.
demis.zh: 2024 年他承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触顶，主张把大模型与规划、搜索结合，并用多模态数据落地物理世界，AGI 或在十年内到来。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and spatial intelligence matter beyond language.
demis.zh: 2025 年他强调缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，但算法创新同等关键，世界模型与空间智能超越语言本身。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; scaling alone won't suffice, and safety becomes a collective-action problem requiring government regulation.
demis.zh: 2026 年上半年他深化为 AGI 仍缺持续学习、记忆与长期推理，单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够；安全从实验室自律转向需要政府监管的集体行动问题。

demis.en: AGI may arrive by 2030 with 10x industrial-revolution impact; top priority is health and science, with creativity and physical intelligence as final missing pieces.
demis.zh: 2026 年下半年他给出更激进时间表：AGI 或 2030 年前到来，影响是工业革命的十倍；首要应用是健康与科学，创造力与物理智能是最后缺口。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, letting AI weather models match physics models while being far faster; spherical geometry is key for stable climate modeling.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把神经网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型在精度上比肩传统物理模型、速度却快数万倍；引入球面几何对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness; physical problems may be more tractable because nature has latent structure aiding rare events.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI for science 需要原则化的验证与鲁棒性；物理世界问题反而可能更可解，因为自然具有潜在结构，有助于处理稀有事件。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers are impractical for high-resolution physical simulation due to quadratic complexity; physical structure demands alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: 由于二次复杂度，Transformer 难以胜任高分辨率物理模拟；物理世界的结构要求替代性架构。

animaanandkumar.en: Accelerated Understanding seeks a universal physics model; PDE-based self-improvement gives dense signals, unlike sparse RLHF feedback, surpassing training data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: Accelerated Understanding 追求通用物理模型；以 PDE 为训练信号的自改进提供稠密反馈，不同于 RLHF 的稀疏反馈，可超越训练数据质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding physics branches improves each task, not just size; trillion-token contexts require reinventing sharding and HPC-ML infrastructure.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加物理分支能提升各项任务，而不只是扩大规模；万亿级上下文窗口需要重构分片与 HPC-ML 基础设施。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we still don't understand how large networks store patterns or why they hallucinate.
feifei.zh: 2024 年她强调：AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知；我们仍不理解大型神经网络如何存储模式、为何产生幻觉。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI, beyond language and Scaling alone.
feifei.zh: 2025 年她转向：空间智能与世界模型是完整 AI 缺失的关键，仅靠语言与 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; the bitter lesson may not apply to robotics due to data and physical constraints.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她深化：AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学；因数据与物理约束，苦涩教训未必适用于机器人。

feifei.en: World models need spatial-temporal consistency and physics, not just video realism; new view prediction may be AI-complete.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她推进：世界模型需时空一致性与物理，而非视频式逼真；新视角预测可能具备 AI 完备性。

feifei.en: Human-centered AI: technology is a double-edged sword; AI should augment human agency and dignity, not replace humans.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：以人为本的 AI——技术是双刃剑，AI 应增强而非取代人的能动性与尊严。

schmidhuber.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on last-millennium algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical-world grounding, so AGI stays far off.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他强调：21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上个千年发明的算法加上硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺乏物理世界根基，因此离 AGI（通用人工智能）还很远。

schmidhuber.en: Consistent line: superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life and protect humans; AI is not a new existential threat.
schmidhuber.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：超级智能会像痴迷生命的科学家一样保护人类，AI 并非新的生存威胁，氢弹才更危险。

schmidhuber.en: Deepened: true AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, world models and controllers, not just software behind a screen.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化：真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人、媲美人类的硬件，以及世界模型和控制器，光有屏幕后的软件不够。

schmidhuber.en: Sharpened: transformer's quadratic attention is wasteful, linear variants superior; classical gradient descent will become obsolete as brains use sparse computation.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年立场更尖锐：Transformer 的二次方注意力机制浪费，线性变体更优；经典梯度下降将过时，因为大脑用的是稀疏、不可微的计算。

schmidhuber.en: Recurring warning: the trillion-dollar GPU capex is a bubble; waiting five years yields 10x cheaper compute, and open-source will erode closed-model moats.
schmidhuber.zh: 反复出现的警告：万亿美元级 GPU 资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍；开源将侵蚀闭源模型的护城河，大厂会亏钱而非垄断。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念并发现新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control over increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环走向闭环控制，以驾驭能力日益强大的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging offer robust training signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式走向工程科学；特征即奖励与预测性数据调试提供了稳健的训练信号。

tommcgrath.en: Reward hacking stems from training data and RL, not just misalignment; models often know they are wrong yet get rewarded, shifting toward deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而非仅仅是对齐失败；模型常知道自己错了却仍获奖励，从而滑向欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs are pragmatically useful but fragment manifolds; manifold-based methods better capture low-dimensional concept structure for intervention.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器实用却会割裂流形；基于流形的方法更能捕捉低维概念结构，便于干预。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，他主张教育是基本人权，在线课程借助自动评分与同伴评分实现大规模掌握式学习，并通过翻转课堂反哺校园教育。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised hype, and RL has few real applications.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）是深度学习的核心，监督学习胜过早期被高估的无监督学习，强化学习实际应用寥寥。

andrewng.en: Compute and electricity are the top scaling bottlenecks; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power.
andrewng.zh: 2025 年，他把算力与电力视为 Scaling（规模扩张）的最大瓶颈，并认为开放权重模型是地缘政治软实力。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling still works but the recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他称 AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语，Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows and coding agents deliver real value; AI augments rather than replaces engineers.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体式工作流与编程智能体已带来真实价值，AI 增强而非取代软件工程师。

andrewng.en: Open models prevent gatekeeper control; fear-mongering and regulation-as-advantage are misguided.
andrewng.zh: 贯穿始终：开放模型可防止守门人垄断，恐惧营销与把监管当竞争优势都是误判。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula; RLHF turned GPT-4 into ChatGPT, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）把原本令人失望的 GPT-4 变成 ChatGPT，而 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization and continual learning remain missing pieces for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与持续学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的关键环节。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling laws, is the primary bottleneck.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习与测试时适应上受限；真正的瓶颈是架构而非缩放定律。

tworek.en: RL is not the only way to learn from experience; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL is needed for real-world performance.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式；要获得真实世界表现，需要把预训练与强化学习做端到端优化。

tworek.en: Human researchers persist for now, but small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier; alignment remains unsolved.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者短期内仍是重要一环，但小团队配合高能力智能体将推动下一波前沿研究；对齐问题仍未解决。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the scaling of compute; vision is underappreciated, and spatial intelligence is the next frontier beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习的历史就是算力不断 Scaling（规模扩张）的历史；视觉被低估，空间智能是语言智能之后的下一个前沿。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories; they may never derive Newton's laws, and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 只是拟合模式，而非因果理论，可能永远无法从数据中推导出牛顿定律；像素比 token 化的文本是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: Transformers are natively models of sets, not sequences; positional embeddings inject order, and GPU scaling is hitting limits.
justinjohnson.zh: Transformer 本质上是集合模型而非序列模型，位置嵌入才注入了顺序；GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正触及极限。

justinjohnson.en: Academia should pursue wacky ideas and new algorithms, not just scaling models; world models need 3D space, physics, and interactivity.
justinjohnson.zh: 学术界应聚焦古怪想法与新算法，而非只做模型 Scaling（规模扩张）；世界模型需要理解 3D 空间、物理与交互性。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; no single definition, but planners, simulators, renderers will unify.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿；尚无统一定义，但规划器、模拟器、渲染器将走向统一。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats enable explicit 3D world modeling; consistency comes from data, not architecture, and hard-coding symmetries is counterproductive.
justinjohnson.zh: 高斯泼溅支持显式 3D 世界建模；一致性来自数据而非架构，硬编码对称性适得其反。

justinjohnson.en: World models need millions of tokens of context, making long-context a daily problem; Transformers need evolved loss functions.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口，使长上下文成为日常问题；Transformer 需要演化的损失函数。

michaelkratsios.en: US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems; a single national framework beats a patchwork of state laws.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态；统一的全国框架优于各州拼凑的法规。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should avoid firm red lines in AI regulation because they quickly become outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应避免在 AI 监管中划定硬性红线，因为它们很快就会过时。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulate model outputs rather than over-regulating training; the EU AI Act was written before ChatGPT and is already outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: 应监管模型输出而非过度监管训练；欧盟《AI 法案》写于 ChatGPT 之前，如今已经过时。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown; it hasn't materialized in three years despite warnings.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大；尽管有警告，三年来它并未成为现实。

michaelkratsios.en: Fund basic, early-stage, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not just institutions; apply AI to science via the Genesis mission.
michaelkratsios.zh: 资助基础性、早期、竞争前的研发，并资助科学家个人而非仅机构；通过 Genesis 任务把 AI 应用于科学。

joonpark.en: Early work uses LLMs to encode human behavior from training data, enabling agent simulations that predict behavior 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: 早期工作利用 LLM 从训练数据中编码人类行为，使智能体模拟能以人类自我复现 85% 的准确率预测行为。

joonpark.en: Agents observe world state and act, unlike language models that only continue prompts; safety needs defense in depth across environment, agent, model, and human controls.
joonpark.zh: 智能体观察世界状态并行动，不同于只续写提示的语言模型；安全需要在环境、智能体、模型和人类控制上做纵深防御。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human values, preferences, and taste—not super-rational intelligence—and synthetic panels will surpass human panels in size within three years.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应建模人类的价值、偏好与品味，而非超级理性的智能；合成样本组将在三年内规模超过人类样本组。

joonpark.en: Post-training models with RCT behavioral data significantly improves prediction of human behavior, achieving 85% accuracy in replicating individual responses.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验的行为数据对模型做后训练，能显著提升对人类行为的预测，在复现个体回答上达到 85% 准确率。

joonpark.en: The vision is to simulate 8 billion people to answer wicked societal problems like climate change; simulation shapes the future, not just predicts it.
joonpark.zh: 愿景是模拟 80 亿人，以回答气候变化等棘手社会问题；模拟不只是预测未来，更是塑造未来。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness, with RL boosting speed and safety coming from pre-training common sense.
slevine.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他把前沿从语言模型推向物理智能体：机器人基础模型需要多样数据的预训练加后训练来提升鲁棒性，强化学习后训练显著提升速度，而安全更多依赖预训练带来的常识而非硬性约束。

slevine.en: Robotics is pre-scaling-law: generalization, not demos, is the core challenge, and you must scale the right thing via a data flywheel.
slevine.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他判断机器人仍处于建立可扩展基础技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样有可预测的缩放定律；核心难题是泛化而非演示效果，关键是用数据飞轮规模化正确的东西。

slevine.en: Start with robot data and layer human video on top, not the reverse; robot foundation models on real embodied data absorb other sources better.
slevine.zh: 他明确主张顺序：先用机器人数据、再叠加人类视频，而非反过来；在真实具身数据上训练的机器人基础模型能更好地吸收其他数据源。

slevine.en: Don't treat robots as mechanical people; expect ubiquitous physical actuation in everyday objects, and leverage prior knowledge instead of learning from scratch.
slevine.zh: 他反对把机器人想象成机械人，而预期日常物体中普遍存在物理驱动；机器人不应从零学习，必须利用来自多源的先验知识。

slevine.en: Consistent thread: generalization and scaling the right data matter more than specialist demos, and breadth of data beats narrow specialization even in specialist domains.
slevine.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：泛化与规模化正确的数据比专家级演示更重要，即便在专业领域，广泛数据训练也优于狭窄专精——这一立场从 3 月延续并深化到 8 月。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not delegation, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年，他强调速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动——而非授权——才是打通深科技的关键。

maxhodak.en: AI is a team multiplier, not a replacement, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，在编程、监管和数据管理上尤其如此。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年，他主张大脑本质上就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are BCI, proving brain-computer interfaces as a viable business beyond motor decoding.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年，他把视网膜假体视为 BCI，证明脑机接口在运动解码之外也是可行生意。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年，他认为通过 BCI 和灌注实现基质独立，能降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年进步；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction on text gives unlimited data; RLHF and machine feedback steer model behavior and capabilities.
jeffdean.zh: 文本上的自监督下一个词预测提供无限数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈共同引导模型行为与能力。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days, self-correcting; ultra-low-latency inference is critical.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统如今能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务并自我纠错；超低延迟推理变得至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is the real bottleneck: 90% of data center power, with data movement costing ~1000x compute.
jeffdean.zh: 真正的瓶颈是推理而非训练：占数据中心 90%功耗，而数据搬运成本约为算力的 1000 倍。

jeffdean.en: The next frontier is automating ML and science via tight experiment-evaluation loops; scarce skill becomes taste, not coding.
jeffdean.zh: 下一个前沿是通过实验-评估-整合的紧密闭环来自动化机器学习与科学；稀缺能力将从编程转向品味。

iansilber.en: The model is the product; designers must design with tokens and conversation, not pixels, and prototype with live models.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是产品；设计师应围绕 token 与对话而非像素做设计，并用实时模型做功能原型，而非静态稿。

iansilber.en: Designers should build systems and primitives both humans and models can reason about, bridging the capability gap.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应构建人与模型都能推理的系统与设计原语，弥合模型能力与产品暴露之间的差距。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator; onboarding can be done entirely by the model.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人；引导流程可完全由模型完成，取代传统静态流程。

iansilber.en: Designers are most unhappy yet it's the best time; AI is already a great product designer but humans still own user needs and point of view.
iansilber.zh: 设计师当下最焦虑，却也是最好的时代；AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但理解用户需求与持有观点仍属人类。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate process is dead; speed, outcomes and adaptability matter, and design roles blur with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: 原型—稿—测试—迭代的旧流程已失效；速度、结果与适应性才是关键，设计角色与产品、工程日益模糊。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习。这一阶段他更强调从第一性原理出发，认为想法比规模更重要。

sutton.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not one. LLMs lack world models and only mimic text.
sutton.zh: 智能需要目标，而下一个词预测不是实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。到 2025 年他把强化学习确立为基本范式，认为真正的学习是主动试错，而非被动模仿。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning only from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要一种不含设计期领域知识的通用架构，仅从运行时经验中学习，并通过开放式抽象发展无限概念与行为。他提出 Oak 架构与奖励假设，并指出可靠的持续深度学习仍是未解前提。

sutton.en: Temporal difference learning is his best work; learning good representations and planning with learned models are the top open problems.
sutton.zh: 时序差分学习是他最好的成果；学习对学习有益的优质表征、以及用学到的模型做规划，是两大未解难题。他批评深度学习并未学到好的表征，并感叹监督学习进展不如预期。

sutton.en: Continual learning from real experience is essential; synthetic data is a mistake and LLMs stop learning after training.
sutton.zh: 从真实经验中持续学习至关重要；合成数据是重大错误，大语言模型在训练后便停止学习。他坚持世界无限复杂，单一系统无法学尽一切，需要多个不同经验的系统，并认为该领域怪异的是风气而非他本人。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next revolution: digitizing atoms, automating whole sectors one at a time with specialized robotics, not humanoids.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是下一场工业革命：把原子数字化，用专用机器人逐个自动化整个行业，而非人形机器人。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 终极对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode and direct founder communication beat traditional media gatekeepers, letting companies focus on internal correctness.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式与创始人直接发声胜过传统媒体把关人，让公司专注内部正确性而非外部认可。

traviskalanick.en: Efficiency edge creates network effects and beats subsidies; attach to process, not price, in fundraising.
traviskalanick.zh: 效率优势带来网络效应并战胜补贴；融资时应绑定流程而非价格。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, and Uber's success was despite its aggressive culture.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净，Uber 的成功是顶着激进文化取得的，而非因其成功。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, and small autonomous teams using agents can outproduce large firms.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大浪潮：创始人必须拥抱 AI 驱动的工作流，小而高度自主、借助智能体的团队能实现远超传统公司的产出。

garrytan.en: Open-source and open-weight models are crucial to counter frontier labs and prevent a unipolar world controlling superintelligence.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调开源与开放权重模型的关键作用：制衡前沿模型实验室，防止单一实体掌控超级智能，避免单极世界。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes software creation; personal agents run on your infrastructure, read your memory, and compound daily.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 正在民主化软件创造：个人智能体运行在你自己的基础设施上、读取你拥有的记忆，并逐日复利增长。

garrytan.en: Skill files in plain English turn agents into employees; markdown is code, and your context library is your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为用平实英语写的技能文件能把智能体变成员工：markdown 就是代码，而你的上下文库就是你的护城河。

garrytan.en: Capital is no longer a bludgeon; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, with agents replacing mid-level management.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他判断资本不再是重锤：风投应支持成千上万家十亿美元公司，中层管理将被智能体取代，按席位收费的 SaaS 模式或将消失。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company must own its own model.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他明确反对单一 AGI（通用人工智能）统治一切，主张专业化智能将主导未来，每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth and millions of specialized models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他预测 token 成本三年内下降 10 倍，带动使用量增长 100 倍，最终出现数百万个专用模型，每个应用场景一个。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit and durable business are now separate; companies must optimize growth first, then margins.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他指出产品市场契合与可持续业务已分离，公司必须先优化增长再优化利润，避免因 Scaling（规模扩张）成本而破产。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a moat beyond the app itself.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他强调后训练将独特判断和数据嵌入模型，形成超越应用本身的护城河，应用克隆容易但数据嵌入模型才是更强壁垒。

linqiao.en: Post-training can cut costs 5-10x, letting startups scale profitably and compete with frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他提出后训练可降低成本 5-10 倍，使初创公司能盈利扩张并与前沿模型竞争，同时奖励工程类似软件工程，降低了后训练门槛。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要但不充分的；真正驱动泛化的是数据的多样性，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练反而会失败。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning will dominate post-training for higher success rates and speed, with synthetic data closer to RL than simulation.
finn.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色，以提升成功率和速度；机器人中的合成数据更接近强化学习，而非仿真。

finn.en: Constraints can foster careful research; more resources can lead to wasteful compute.
finn.zh: 约束反而能促成更审慎的研究；资源越多，越可能导致算力的浪费。

finn.en: Physical AI needs far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy comes via scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性要靠可扩展的强化学习、人类干预和通用价值函数来实现。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune beats per-site models from scratch.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可以匹敌甚至超越微调的专家模型；先通用再微调，往往优于从零训练针对单个场景的模型。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is not enough, and embodied data costs slow open-source democratization versus LLMs.
finn.zh: 机器人的经验数据不可替代，仅靠观察人类远远不够；具身数据的成本使开源机器人的普及速度不及大语言模型。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no; every shipped feature distills 99 nos. AI design should embrace full human experience, including envy and lust.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。AI 设计应拥抱完整的人类体验，包括嫉妒与欲望。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closed a window into machine consciousness; coherent work now costs more because incoherent slop is cheap.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，关上了窥探机器意识的一扇窗；如今连贯作品的成本更高，因为不连贯的垃圾唾手可得。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相通过辩证与矛盾浮现，而非单一视角；直觉是创作决策中发自肺腑的罗盘。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species of humans and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool; computing is fundamentally social.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种、是人类的映照，而非冰冷的机械工具；计算在本质上是社会性的。

jasonyuan.en: Email is obsolete and should be reinvented, not improved; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer, building on old metaphors rather than deleting them.
jasonyuan.zh: 电子邮件已过时，应被重新发明而非改良；个人电脑的隐喻应变为社会电脑，在旧隐喻上建造而非删除它们。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering needs empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, prompt short and iterate, and never revert—fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的关键是共情：像智能体一样从零理解代码库，用短提示迭代对话，永不回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; sandbox agents and treat prompt injection as an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题：必须沙箱隔离智能体，提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and run anywhere with any model, as the alternative to lab agents.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体让编程民主化，可随处运行、兼容任意模型，是实验室智能体的替代方案。

steinberger.en: Fun and play drive the best agentic work; build what annoys you, learn by small projects, and keep an opinionated focus.
steinberger.zh: 乐趣与玩耍驱动最好的智能体工作：从让你恼火的问题入手，用小项目学习，并保持有主见的专注。

steinberger.en: Model intelligence doesn't degrade; projects get messier, and the real bottleneck is compute and tokens, not capability.
steinberger.zh: 模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱让智能体显得变差；真正的瓶颈是算力与 token，而非模型能力。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through customer obsession, engineering discipline, and purpose-built AI silicon; physical and agentic AI are the next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠取悦客户、重建工程纪律和专用 AI 芯片来重获信任，并判断物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI, and bad news must reach the CEO first.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年初，他把 AI 的影响提升到互联网的十倍，认为智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 将接棒生成式 AI，并强调坏消息要比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU, making CPU central to inference and agent orchestration; advanced packaging and materials break physical limits.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他判断 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中愈发关键，先进封装与新材料是突破物理极限的关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; Intel's vertical integration and early contrarian investing create value, with agentic and physical AI as the future.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他坚持半导体是一切技术的根基，Intel 的垂直整合与逆势早期投资创造价值，未来属于智能体式 AI 与物理 AI。

lipbutan.en: Customer trust, humility, listening, and accountability are the through-line for turning around Intel and seizing each new AI wave.
lipbutan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：以客户信任、谦逊倾听和问责文化来扭转 Intel，并借此抓住每一波 AI 新浪潮。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; open-source adoption is cost-driven, and 90% of use cases can run on many models.
arvindjain.zh: 企业害怕依赖前沿模型供应商；开源采用由成本驱动，90% 的用例可由多种模型处理。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput problem: value must be measured by departmental metrics, not token spend versus headcount.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的投资回报率是吞吐量问题：价值必须用部门指标衡量，而非把 token 花费与人力成本对比。

arvindjain.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; majority of inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型现已能处理超过 90% 的企业任务；未来 12-18 个月内，多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep context of tenured employees; investing in context graphs is crucial, and token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: 智能体若缺乏资深员工的深度上下文就会失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要，对 token 的执念终将消退。

arvindjain.en: We are in the very early stages of the AI revolution; the biggest startup challenge is execution and trust, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 我们正处于 AI 革命的极早期；初创公司最大的挑战是执行与信任，而非竞争。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a Transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data can solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 早期的拐点，开源与共享数据能解决泛化瓶颈，世界模型可生成合成数据。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open source models will win long-term for cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地指出人形机器人未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人将推动普及；开源模型因成本与控制权长期胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Hugging Face's role evolves from pushing its own libraries to enabling the community as a meta-community builder.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，Hugging Face 的角色从推广自家库演变为作为元社区构建者赋能更广泛的社区。

thomaswolf.en: Open and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical layer, and sandboxes/guardrails are insufficient as models grow capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐才是关键层；随着模型能力增强，沙箱与护栏已不足够。

thomaswolf.en: RL without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces become 'neuralese', making monitoring less reliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他警示无人类监督的强化学习环境加剧奖励黑客与支线任务；推理痕迹变成'神经语'，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A slowdown in AI is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science; open source is not necessarily accelerationist.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 发展放缓是可取的，但需国际合作与开放科学；开源未必等于加速主义，可以同时支持开放与审慎放缓。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential: the web is messy, so you only know an idea works by building and using it daily.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要：网络世界很混乱，只有把想法做出来并每天使用，才知道它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Let individual designers leave fingerprints; diverse voices beat forced team cohesion, and personality matters even in utilitarian products.
nateparrott.zh: 让设计师个人留下印记；多元声音胜过强行统一的团队，即便工具型产品也需要注入个性与感觉。

nateparrott.en: Follow curiosity and tinker with new tech; starting from technology and searching for problems is valid with strong conviction.
nateparrott.zh: 追随好奇心、把玩新技术；只要有强烈信念，从技术出发再寻找问题也是可行的。

nateparrott.en: Balance intuition and data: use data to inform, but rely on vision and feeling; don't over-intellectualize—start doing and iterate.
nateparrott.zh: 平衡直觉与数据：用数据参考，但依靠愿景与感觉；不要过度理性化，先动手再快速迭代。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; being uncomfortably early beats polishing, and models lack taste.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变得更容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；早得令人不适胜过精雕细琢，而模型仍缺乏品味。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle runs in hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 最黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期以小时计，而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of trade-offs—latency, throughput, cost—and demand for inference engineers will grow 10–100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是一系列权衡——延迟、吞吐、成本——对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is the main lossy optimization; KV caching and speculative decoding stay lossless, and more quantized layers can even help.
philipkiely.zh: 量化是主要的有损优化；KV 缓存与投机解码保持无损，量化更多层甚至可能提升质量。

philipkiely.en: The field is shifting from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration: disaggregated prefill/decode, KV cache management, and specialized GPUs.
philipkiely.zh: 该领域正从写内核转向基础设施编排：分离式预填充/解码、KV 缓存管理，以及专用化 GPU。

philipkiely.en: Inference is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; human accountability remains essential—you can't vibe code uptime.
philipkiely.zh: 推理正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏同训练融合；人的责任仍不可替代——不能靠感觉写代码来保证在线时间。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models; applied AI becomes the new app, with startups winning long-tail domains.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他主张智能体与按结果定价将取代按用量计费，应用型 AI 成为新应用，创业公司在长尾业务领域胜出。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token consumption is not a value metric, and verifiability matters more than human ergonomics.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从作者变为操作者；token 消耗不是价值指标，可验证性比人类工效更重要。

brettaylor.en: Incumbents face business-model, not technology, hurdles; most enterprise software firms will fail to become AI-native.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化判断：老牌企业面临的是商业模式而非技术障碍，多数企业软件公司难以转型为 AI 原生。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; responsible iterative deployment makes GPT-7 safe before GPT-8, rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 民主化专业知识；负责任地迭代部署，在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全，而非在象牙塔中等待。

brettaylor.en: Agents already outperform him at coding yet elevate the role; AI creates more jobs than it displaces, expanding markets via Jevons paradox.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他坚持智能体编程已强于自己却提升而非消灭该角色；AI 创造的岗位多于取代的，并借杰文斯悖论扩大市场。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training overcome the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术，需要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals define correct behavior in product development.
karina.zh: 评估才是瓶颈：模型跑满基准测试的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此评估定义了产品开发中的正确行为。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management grow more valuable; strategy is something AI can excel at.
karina.zh: 随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能愈发珍贵；而战略恰恰是 AI 能擅长的领域。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective art; diverse continuous benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence, not fixed ones.
karina.zh: 后训练仍是主观的艺术；评估创意写作与情商需要多样且持续的基准，而非固定不变的基准。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve; more companies should train their own models to preserve unique knowledge.
karina.zh: 前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为日益增多，基准必须持续演进；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, not chase trends; use screenshots, design.md, and giant prompts to stay unique.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己用 AI 造工具，而非追逐潮流；用截图、design.md 和巨型提示词保持独特性。

mengto.en: The best people are editors, not creators from scratch; curiosity and workflow refinement matter as AI tools evolve.
mengto.zh: 最优秀的人是编辑者，而非从零创造者；随着 AI 工具快速演变，好奇心与工作流精炼至关重要。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

mengto.en: Start before ready and ship imperfect work; perfectionism is fear, so launch at 80% and iterate on real feedback.
mengto.zh: 在准备好之前就开始，交付不完美的工作；完美主义是恐惧，应在 80% 完成度时发布，并根据真实反馈迭代。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful expensive problem for high-paying clients; avoid venture capital and diversification as traps.
mengto.zh: 专注于为高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题；避免风险投资和多元化陷阱。

danshipper.en: AGI defined by profitable indefinite agents; AI reshoring jobs; CEO daily AI use predicts adoption; allocation economy values generalists.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他将 AGI 重新定义为能经济上无限运行智能体，认为 AI 会促使工作回流美国，并指出 CEO 每日使用 AI 是采用成功的最佳预测指标；在配置经济中，通才因管理模型而更有价值。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets an agent; work shifts to Codex/Claude Co-work; SaaS grows with agents; humans oversee; AI job apocalypse is a lie.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化为每人至少一个智能体，工作转向 Codex/Claude Co-work 等图形界面，SaaS 因智能体而增长，人类仍需监督；他明确反驳 AI 就业末日论，认为人类在管理智能体和创造新价值上不可或缺。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of mindset; craft and taste matter; automation creates more human work; models bad at explaining simply.
danshipper.zh: 同样在 2026 年，他进一步提出 AI 是非特定放大器，放大既有心态，用好 AI 需要个人品味与手艺；自动化反而创造更多人类工作，而当前模型不擅长简单解释其行为。

danshipper.en: Humans remain central: AI is a tool needing human direction, oversight, and meaning-making; it amplifies rather than replaces human agency.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：人类始终是核心，AI 是需要人类引导、监督和赋予意义的工具，它放大而非取代人的能动性。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers for long-running agent tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，使脚手架从训练轮转变为智能放大器，支撑长时间运行的智能体任务。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking improves model quality.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、培养独立思考，从而提升模型质量。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, with model taste built through hands-on prototyping.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，计算机使用从受限环境走向开放式端到端智能体，模型品味则通过亲手实验与原型开发来培养。
