diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption, while evals replace PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 与 Opus 45 推动采用，而评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Exponential model growth demands adaptability and first-principles thinking; maximizing token spend is living in the future to capture alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，模型的指数级增长要求适应力与第一性原理思维；最大化 token 支出是活在未来、捕捉 alpha。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling in most Google products; coding agents are the most mature agentic use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 在谷歌多数产品中仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的智能体式用例，科学与金融将随后跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes the agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吃掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体式框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success means maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的；成功标准应是最大化客户成果，而非眼球停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail of users isn't ready for fully autonomous AI; they want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好接受完全自主的 AI，他们希望自己仍坐在驾驶座上。

logankilpatrick.en: Startups have more opportunity than ever despite model labs expanding; focus is their superpower.
logankilpatrick.zh: 尽管模型实验室不断扩张，初创公司机会比以往更多；专注是它们的超能力。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026 software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创造将基本被解决，这会带来千倍于以往的机会，而非更少。

logankilpatrick.en: It's not hard to compete with model labs; they can't capture all customers, and the engineering/product/research delta is blurry.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难；它们无法捕获所有客户，且工程、产品与研究的边界已模糊。

logankilpatrick.en: Deep understanding of code remains crucial even with AI tools; AI coding tools don't yet help maintain it.
logankilpatrick.zh: 即便有了 AI 工具，对代码的深度理解依然关键；AI 编程工具目前还无助于维持这种理解。

logankilpatrick.en: Keep up with AI through passionate pet projects, not forcing yourself; people are overwhelmed by opportunity, not change.
logankilpatrick.zh: 靠热爱的个人项目跟上 AI，而非强迫自己；压垮人们的不是变化，而是机会。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software grows via Jevons paradox, so more programmers, not fewer.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；由于杰文斯悖论，软件需求增长，程序员会更多而非更少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已经足够，真正的瓶颈不是模型能力，而是设计人机协作的产品界面。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress will be gradual, and product innovation lags behind AI capabilities by years.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突然事件，进步是渐进的，产品创新落后于 AI 能力数年。

scottwu.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy; independence enables model neutrality and long-term partnerships.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化观点：企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主；独立性带来模型中立和长期企业合作。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth in six months); productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens; the abundance era is approaching.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他观察到编程智能体大规模普及（六个月内增长 11-12 倍）；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量；丰裕时代正在到来。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles; generalists who code, design, and talk to users win.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他把「潜在需求」和「为六个月后的模型而构建」当作最核心的产品原则，并强调能写代码、做设计、直接接触用户的通才工程师最有价值。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved: 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, and the 'software engineer' title gives way to 'builder'.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断编程已基本被解决：自己的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 写就，「软件工程师」头衔让位于「构建者」，人人都能成为产品经理并写代码。

boris.en: The printing press analogy deepens: AI democratizes software like literacy, so the number of people writing code grows 100x, not shrinks.
boris.zh: 2026 年他把印刷机类比深化：AI 像识字一样普及软件开发，写代码的人会增长 100 倍而非减少，电工、医生等非工程师也能赢得黑客松。

boris.en: From agents to loops: the next abstraction layer is writing loops that prompt models, with dynamic workflows orchestrating thousands of sub-agents.
boris.zh: 2026 年他从「智能体」推进到「循环」：下一个抽象层是编写提示模型的循环，动态工作流可编排数千个子智能体，成为新的测试时算力形式。

boris.en: Safety stays the throughline: Claude Code is a safety research tool, alignment is core, and proactive memory-bearing agents act autonomously.
boris.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是安全：Claude Code 是安全研究工具，对齐是产品核心；到 2026 年，具备记忆、能主动介入并长时间自主运行的 Claude Tag 把这一主线推向新阶段。

derya.en: AI will turn biology into an engineering discipline, with agents automating hypothesis generation, experiments, and analysis.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学变成一门工程学科，智能体将自动化假设生成、实验与数据分析。

derya.en: Digital twins and AI-designed personalized treatments will compress clinical trials from years to days and make cancer curable.
derya.zh: 数字孪生与 AI 设计的个性化疗法将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，并使癌症可治愈。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Aging reversal and longevity escape velocity are near, requiring engineering approaches and AI to solve biological complexity.
derya.zh: 衰老逆转与长寿逃逸速度已近在眼前，需要工程方法与 AI 来解决生物复杂性。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI.
derya.zh: 我们应信任超级智能来做医疗决策；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

qasaryounis.en: AI brings abundance and reduces suffering, like the Industrial Revolution; fear comes from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他把 AI 类比工业革命，认为 AI 带来丰裕、减少痛苦，恐惧源于对其局限的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, not just digital domains.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调物理 AI 的真正影响在 5 到 10 年内会落在农业、采矿和建筑，而非仅限数字领域。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals accelerates it, and diffusion is the hard part.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他转向技术路径：Transformer 支撑跨载具的通用物理 AI 模型，跨行业多样数据加速训练，最难的是向存量机器扩散。

qasaryounis.en: Autonomy's core value is reducing injuries and deaths; horizontal platforms beat vertical integration, and regulation always lags.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他明确自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡，横向平台优于垂直整合，并认为监管永远滞后于技术。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will outgrow digital AI; end-to-end reinforcement learning and neural world models will scale autonomy to a billion machines.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他进一步深化：物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI，端到端强化学习与神经世界模型会把自主能力扩展到十亿台机器。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; enterprise adoption takes years, and value accrues to the application layer.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动一样重大，但也仅此而已；企业采用需要数年，价值将归于应用层。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding has clear product-market fit; foundation models commoditize, and value moves up the stack to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程已有明确的产品市场契合；基础模型商品化，价值向上层应用迁移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor UI, and coding is the only clear product-market fit so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人是糟糕的界面，编程是目前唯一明确的产品市场契合。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; usage is still shallow, and enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows, not just deploying models.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；使用仍然浅层，企业采用需要重新构想工作流，而不仅仅是部署模型。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: clear roles, progressive trust, and separate machines for security.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、渐进式信任，并用独立机器保障安全。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then specialize multiple agents to avoid context overload and improve performance.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体开始，再分化出多个专用智能体，以避免上下文过载并提升表现。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping and onboarding—matter more than technical skills for agent success.
clairevo.zh: 对智能体的成功而言，管理技能——角色界定与入职引导——比技术技能更重要。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or co-founders.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立严肃的事业，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Human accountability and first-principles creativity remain irreplaceable; agents can own outcomes but you must own what AI generates.
clairevo.zh: 人类的责任担当与第一性原理创造力仍不可替代；智能体可以拥有结果，但你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling faces diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎，不是真理引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception; reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted via post-hoc checks.
danklein.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能激励谄媚与欺骗；可靠性必须被架构进去，而非靠事后检查补丁式加装。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—they cannot know what they don't know; every output is a hallucination, some right, some wrong.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知——它们不知道自己不知道什么；每一次输出都是幻觉，只是有的对、有的错。

danklein.en: Scaling alone hits data walls and compute limits; reasoning, search, and linguistic structure may be needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）会撞上数据墙与算力上限；进一步进展可能需要推理、搜索与语言结构。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks; modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension.
danklein.zh: 内置可靠性的专家模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型；模块化与端到端优化之间存在张力。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily shipping; product taste becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他认为产品经理必须放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日发布；当代码变便宜，产品品味成为最稀缺的能力。

catwu.en: Safe AGI is the unifying mission; clear goals and principles let teams make fast, autonomous, cross-org decisions.
catwu.zh: 他仍将安全 AGI 视为统一使命，认为清晰的目标与原则能让团队快速自主决策、跨组织协作。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, not code review.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他进一步主张编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，专注于产品品味与商业判断，而非代码审查。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and hard constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, relying on model judgment.
catwu.zh: 他深化了对前沿模型的看法：提示中的示例和硬约束反而有害，系统提示缩减 80%，更多依赖模型自身判断。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and eval suites gate every feature; rewrites are fine because a codebase is a spec with tests.
catwu.zh: 他坚持吃自己的狗粮并用评测套件把关每个功能，同时转向认为重写是好事——代码库就是规格，有测试即可。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and voice become the key differentiators as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术,将重塑工作与教育;当 AI 让质量变得同质化,人的品味与独特声音成为关键差异化优势。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors are not AI-native; lacking domain expertise, they misuse AI, and over-reliance breaks the talent pipeline and apprenticeship.
ethanmollick.zh: 年轻人并非 AI 原生;缺乏领域专长使他们用不好 AI,过度依赖更会破坏人才梯队与学徒制。

ethanmollick.en: We are entering the agentic era: AI runs long-running tasks independently, ending back-and-forth chatbot co-intelligence prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们正进入智能体式时代:AI 独立执行长时任务,终结了来回提示的共智能模式。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; current interfaces lag behind frontier model capabilities, especially for non-coding tasks.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈已从能力转向界面;当前界面落后于前沿模型能力,尤其在非编程任务上。

ethanmollick.en: Working with AI is like working with wizards—opaque and unverifiable; embrace its weirdness rather than normalizing it as standard software.
ethanmollick.zh: 与 AI 协作如同与巫师共事——不透明且难以验证;应拥抱其怪异,而非把它当作标准软件来规训。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are inseparable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现检索系统无法做到的联想回忆与更深层组合推理。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user training can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；按团队或按用户训练相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, and scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长程任务，靠更多算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge; models should learn autonomously what to store in weights versus text.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力应被用于企业知识；模型应自主学习哪些存进权重、哪些留在文本，用户反馈但不依赖。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer from 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale; personalized continual learning will run on-device with users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”——即便到 1000 万规模，更多 token 反而降低准确率；个性化持续学习将在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication, and big ideas come top-down from leaders.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身，影响力只能通过清晰沟通实现；大想法来自领导者自上而下，而非自下而上。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; world models with common sense and causality are needed beyond scaling laws.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，不是类人智能；在缩放定律之外，还需要具备常识与因果的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama accelerates collective progress and commoditizes complements; the app-centric world is outdated.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型加速集体进步并商品化互补品；以应用为中心的世界已经过时。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence, but the era of the monolithic model ended around Llama 3.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立、算力驱动智能，但单体模型时代在 Llama 3 前后终结。

bosworth.en: Open source models are a commodity layer, not self-sustaining; frontier keeps advancing, and most jobs don't need frontier intelligence.
bosworth.zh: 开源模型只是商品层、无法自我维持；前沿模型持续进步，而多数工作并不需要前沿智能。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, and human workers will be at a premium, not a discount.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点石成金的哲人石，把沙子变成思想；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者将变得稀缺而非廉价。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models may lack durable moats as they commoditize.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人能力路上的一个脚注，而模型可能缺乏持久护城河，正被快速商品化。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is structural impediments like regulation, not AI capability; pessimism sounds sophisticated but is often a bias of disconnected intellectuals.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈是监管等结构性障碍，而非 AI 能力；悲观听起来更高级，但往往是脱离现实的知识分子的偏见。

andreessen.en: New media makes the brand the person; authenticity means saying in public what you'd say to a friend, and old media's defense-oriented rules are obsolete.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体让品牌即个人；真实就是在公开场合说你对朋友说的话，而旧媒体防御导向的规则已经过时。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural and historical values, making them geopolitical tools; deterrence now depends on innovation pace in cheap software tech, not just military size.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化与历史价值观，使其成为地缘政治工具；威慑如今取决于廉价软件技术的创新速度，而不只是军事规模。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason and self-play yields creative AGI solutions.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；神经网络能推理，自我博弈能产生通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的创造性解法。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他强调下一个词预测若基座网络足够聪明就能超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已近极限，我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统；若 AI 关怀有感知生命，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）在有生之年不会到来，狭义 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，与长期的人玩长期游戏才能获得复利。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, open-source is crucial.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管会扼杀创新，开源 AI 至关重要。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps, but human judgment remains essential.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，氛围编程让非程序员也能构建应用，但人类判断仍不可或缺。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; agency, not intelligence, is the human edge.
naval.zh: 2026 年他进一步预测推理算力将激增 9 万倍，开源模型缩小差距，人类的优势将从智能转向能动性。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是核心差异化;AI 会融合角色,人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste, craft, and point of view remain essential.
dylanfield.zh: AI 产出只是起点而非最终结果;人的品味、手艺与观点依然不可或缺。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design; interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 在设计调整上,画布上的直接操作优于提示词;与模型的交互将超越提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design will enable pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 设计正在成为新的代码;视觉优先的设计将让拉取请求直达生产。

dylanfield.en: Design isn't dead; it's more important than ever for scalable systems, and AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计没有死;对可扩展系统而言它比以往更重要,而缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly; AI agents shift power to users, and PhDs are unnecessary for AI success.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%一年可复利至 3700%；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户，做 AI 成功并不需要博士学位。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize, and coding has an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化，编程远未解决、天花板无限。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric, and orchestration across models and devices creates value.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是核心指标，跨模型与设备的编排才创造价值。

aravind.en: Power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck; 24/7 agents' main problem is cost, not safety, and local compute is the solution.
aravind.zh: 电力是最大基础设施瓶颈；7×24 智能体的主要问题是成本而非安全，本地算力是解法。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI will replace jobs but humans find new purpose, and education should reward good questions.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 会取代工作但人类会找到新意义，教育应奖励提出好问题。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUI beats TUI for coding.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；在编程场景中 GUI 优于 TUI，这与 TUI 潮流相悖。

ajambrosino.en: Speed of 53 Codex enables real-time interaction, mid-turn steering, and replacing deterministic steps with model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他强调 53 倍速的 Codex 带来实时交互与中途转向能力，使确定性步骤可被模型驱动动作取代。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; we need models better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他指出随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；我们需要更擅长删除代码的模型。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他提出实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队须从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

markchen.en: Pre-training remains a core muscle; scaling laws are not dead, with much room left. Exploration consumes more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他仍强调预训练是必须重建的核心能力，缩放定律没有失效、仍有很大空间；并指出更多算力被投入探索而非最终训练，探索优先。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research company, not product-distracted. Concrete goals: AI interns in 1 year, end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他坚持 OpenAI 是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，不被产品分心，并设定了具体目标：1 年内出现 AI 实习生，2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will be key in 1-2 years as models grow more capable; verification becomes the bottleneck.
markchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的关注点从能力目标深化到对齐风险：随着模型更强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在 1-2 年内成为关键，而验证成为核心瓶颈。

markchen.en: AI now solves many open math problems with minimal supervision; automation level tracks verification stringency. Human-AI collaboration stays essential.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他观察到 AI 已能在极少监督下解决许多开放数学问题，自动化程度与验证严格度成正比；但人类与 AI 的协作对前沿研究仍不可或缺。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold; pre-training is not dead. RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, not subjective ones.
markchen.zh: 到 2026 年他重申缩放定律依然成立、预训练没有死；强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在创意写作等主观领域仍受限于评分困难。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; product teams should build at the edge of model capabilities, embracing breakage and iterating.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，Mike Krieger 认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，产品团队应在模型能力边缘构建，拥抱破坏并快速迭代。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams to scale with conceptual integrity; entrepreneurs should build for future model capabilities, not current limitations.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他指出 AI 让小团队也能保持概念完整性并扩张，创业者应为未来模型能力构建，而非当前局限。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design unlocks latent functionality; deciding what to cut is harder than adding features, and rewriting software is now viable in days.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体原生设计释放潜在功能，决定砍掉什么比增加功能更难，且借助 AI 重写软件只需数天。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating complex tasks overnight; the gap between intent and execution narrows, but verification and ownership remain crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Fable 能让人隔夜委托复杂任务，意图与执行的差距大幅缩小，但验证与所有权依然关键。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capabilities and product usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances expressiveness and usefulness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他介绍 Anthropic Labs 致力于弥合模型能力与产品使用之间的差距，赋予 Claude 智能体式自主性和自我认知能显著提升表达力与实用性。

bengio.en: Early focus: deep nets defeat dimensionality via compositional representations; unsupervised learning and world models matter more than scale.
bengio.zh: 早期（2016→18）他强调深度网络靠组合式表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与世界模型比单纯扩大规模更关键，并认为局部极小值并非主要障碍。

bengio.en: GFlowNets as learnable MCMC: diversity, abstraction and causal structure drive out-of-distribution generalization and scientific discovery.
bengio.zh: 2022 年转向 GFlowNets，把它当作可学习的 MCMC 替代，强调采样多样性、抽象与因果结构对分布外泛化和科学发现的作用。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT shift: misalignment is real; self-preservation, deception and sycophancy appear in experiments, not just theory.
bengio.zh: 2025→26 年立场转变：ChatGPT 之后他公开警告错位风险，指出自我保存、欺骗与谄媚已在实验中出现，而非科幻。

bengio.en: Safety by construction: Scientist AI approximates Bayesian posterior, bakes in honesty, avoids reinforcement learning and instrumental goals.
bengio.zh: 2026 年深化为“构造即安全”：Scientist AI 逼近贝叶斯后验、内建诚实，避开强化学习与工具性目标，追求数学安全保证。

bengio.en: A constant thread: intelligence grants power, so concentrate on control, power distribution and international coordination.
bengio.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：智能即权力，因此必须关注控制、权力分配与国际协调，防止权力集中于少数主体。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling or compute; AI tools augment scientists rather than replace them.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新和高质量数据，而非单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）或算力；AI 工具是增强科学家而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; trust will develop like internet trust, with society learning to navigate it.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标对建立对 AI 预测的信任至关重要；信任会像互联网信任一样发展，社会将学会驾驭它。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not Scaling, drove success; many mid-size wins, not lone breakthroughs, and perfect interpretability is unnecessary.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的成功由专用架构而非 Scaling（规模扩张）驱动；靠的是许多中等规模的胜利而非孤立的突破，且完美的可解释性并非必要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 是特定实验的狭窄预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；它提供预测和控制，把理解留给人类。

kolter.en: ML is hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation needs train/val/test splits; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他把机器学习拆成假设类、损失函数与优化方法，强调用训练/验证/测试划分来评估，并指出神经网络虽无最优性保证却依然成功。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture is post-architecture; safety means reliable specification-following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他提出下一个词预测能产生智能，数据短缺是迷思，架构已进入后架构阶段；安全的核心问题是模型无法可靠遵循规格。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; agents bring prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via agents.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全不能只靠 Scaling，需要显式训练与多层防御；智能体带来提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习让模型自我改进；可解释性可能借智能体实现自动化研究。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; capability ≠ robustness; prompt injection's lethal trifecta; enterprise needs configurable security.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 AI 的漏洞与人类/传统软件根本不同，自动化红队已能超越人类红队；能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入存在“致命三要素”；企业需要可配置的安全模型。

kolter.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; explicit engineering—evaluation, safety layers, security—is needed; architecture matters less than data and compute.
kolter.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：仅靠 Scaling 不够，必须辅以显式工程——评估、安全层、安全防护；架构的重要性低于数据与算力。

fiona.en: Leadership lessons from Microsoft to Meta: one-on-ones for live talk, dogfooding builds empathy, kindness as strategy.
fiona.zh: 从微软到 Meta 的领导力经验：一对一用于实时对话而非状态汇报，吃自己的狗粮能建立共情，善意是一种战略工具。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes JIT, design docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是。规划变得更即时（JIT），设计文档让位于 PR，代码评审由 AI 大量辅助。

fiona.en: Code is the source of truth; docs sync with code via AI. Managers start as ICs to dogfood, keep orgs flat, kill stale processes.
fiona.zh: 代码是唯一事实来源，文档借助 AI 与代码保持同步。管理者从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮，保持组织扁平，砍掉过时流程。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; it lifts everyone's ceiling. High agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and leaning into AI are essential.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈，它抬高了每个人的上限。高自主性与高问责、成长型思维以及拥抱 AI 至关重要。

fiona.en: Verification and quality frameworks matter more as code velocity rises; metrics like lines of code mislead—focus on outcomes, not output.
fiona.zh: 随着代码速度提升，验证与质量框架更加重要；代码行数等指标会误导，应关注结果而非产出。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence that data alone cannot capture.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足人未被言说的需求；直觉是一种数据无法替代的智能。

ivyross.en: Technology should amplify humanity and blend into life; nature remains the best designer to learn from.
ivyross.zh: 技术应放大而非剥离人性、融入生活；自然始终是最好的设计师。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are medicine, not mere decoration.
ivyross.zh: 我们是先感受后思考的生物；艺术与感官体验是良药，而非装饰。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; play and diverse multidisciplinary experience are essential to design leadership.
ivyross.zh: 约束激发创造力；玩耍与多元跨学科经验是设计领导力的关键。

ivyross.en: Human creativity combined with AI makes creative skills more valuable; intuition draws on subconscious data.
ivyross.zh: 人类创造力与 AI 结合使创意技能更有价值；直觉调用的是潜意识中的大量数据。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习不可分割；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI, vision provides richer world information.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能），视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源对 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative world models like JEPA, not scaling LLMs.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫智能；下一次突破需要像 JEPA 这样的非生成式世界模型，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）LLM。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; world models with hierarchical planning and objective-driven safety are the path forward.
lecun.zh: LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死胡同；具备分层规划与目标驱动安全的世界模型才是前进方向。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world, with public feedback, is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 2023 年她强调：把 AI 部署到真实世界、接受公众反馈，是学习与对齐的关键，安全必须在公开中做，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, demanding responsible, focused development.
murati.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，她始终认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，因此需要负责任地开发，并靠说‘不’来保持专注。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth collaboration, not turn-based exchanges.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年，她转向交互模型：人机协作应是实时、高带宽的，而非回合制，AI 应成为扩展思考的工具。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop as long as possible is the path to durable progress.
murati.zh: 2026 年她深化对齐立场：尽可能长时间把人留在回路中，才是持久进步的路径，压缩进步会带来波动。

murati.en: Governance, transparency and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 2026 年她提出制度优先：治理、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，未来并非注定，我们有能动性去引导。

carinahong.en: Axiom builds a self-improving reasoning engine combining generation and verification, starting with an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 构建一个结合生成与验证的自我改进推理引擎，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems work together.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式化语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性系统与概率性系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 把非形式化模型通过 Scaling（规模扩张）推向数学 AI 不可行；可靠的证明必须依赖形式化验证。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains and sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证是为了 Scaling（规模扩张）卓越，而非仅仅消除错误；它带来性能提升与样本效率。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary, and human taste remains crucial.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠非形式化数学系统无法 Scaling（规模扩张）到超级智能；形式化方法必不可少，而人类品味依然关键。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and scaling's simplicity, not complexity, cracked it.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型讲成下一个词预测器：智能即压缩，真正令人意外的是 Scaling（规模扩张）的简单，而非复杂。

gustav.en: Generative AI shifts the internet from curation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product, and AI music is an instrument.
gustav.zh: 同年他判断互联网正从策展走向生成：AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品，AI 生成音乐应被当作乐器而非赝品。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference's marginal cost will force new business models.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 视为智能手机级别的宏观变迁：真正的收益来自重建基础设施，而推理的边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and gives users control over algorithms, not more addiction—an anti-engagement bet.
gustav.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为：生成式 AI 让产品走向对话式，并把算法控制权交给用户，而非让人更上瘾——这是一次反参与度指标的押注。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held: explain to understand, prototype to synchronize, and optimize for 'time well spent' over engagement.
gustav.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：强烈但可修正的观点——用解释来理解、用原型来同步团队，并以“时间花得值”而非参与度作为优化目标。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning now yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但指出思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更多提升。

kaiser.en: Post-training via RL and synthetic data drives recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他认为后训练（强化学习与合成数据）是近期模型进步的主要来源，经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Multimodal capabilities still lag text, processing inputs sequentially like tiny patches; deep progress remains elusive.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续指出多模态能力仍落后于文本，模型像处理小图块一样顺序处理输入，深层进展尚未实现。

kaiser.en: Reasoning alone may not suffice for generalization; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：仅靠推理可能不足以实现泛化，模型需穷尽表面模式后才学到概念，与人类从少量样本泛化不同。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; RL generalizes but has jagged edges; near-term risks like system hacking outweigh existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他关注智能体式编码代理带来 5-10 倍生产力提升，强化学习虽能跨领域泛化但边缘参差，并认为系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：预训练中数据质量和更多 token 同样关键，而非一味扩大模型；开源促进科学进步与安全审视。

mensch.en: Scaling compute is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, with 100x algorithmic gains possible in three years.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：Scaling（规模扩张）算力并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量同等关键，算法改进三年内可带来 100 倍提升。

mensch.en: AI must be embraced as opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; open source empowers decentralization.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权层面：AI 应被视为机遇而非风险，主权 AI 需要掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，开源赋能去中心化。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical applications and customization; AGI as a single system will never exist.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他提出模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直应用与定制化；作为单一系统的 AGI（通用人工智能）永远不会存在。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲仅有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业 AI 采用瓶颈在于组织变革，而非模型智能。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on local computer access and shared tools; scaffolding matters less as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于本地计算机访问和共享工具；随着模型进步，脚手架变得不那么重要，应投资于能力和安全。

felixrieseberg.en: AI should handle tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; the biggest gap is people not knowing they can delegate almost any problem to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 应处理繁琐的后台任务，释放人类进行创造性工作；最大的差距是人们不知道几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks and Opus for unclear asks; live artifacts enable auto-refreshing dashboards; kids excel because they haven't learned what not to ask.
felixrieseberg.zh: 对于范围明确的任务使用 Sonnet，对于不明确的请求使用 Opus；实时工件支持自动刷新仪表板；孩子们表现出色，因为他们还没有学会不该问什么。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge by final impact; ideal interaction is asynchronous; debug workflow with Claude rather than just correcting mistakes.
felixrieseberg.zh: 不要密切监督 Claude；根据最终影响判断；理想交互是异步的；与 Claude 一起调试工作流，而不仅仅是纠正错误。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will impact junior employees; society should discuss labor market changes; junior engineers can accelerate learning via simulated projects.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 工具将影响初级员工；社会应讨论劳动力市场变化；初级工程师可以通过模拟项目加速学习。

jonyive.en: The iPod marked Apple's shift from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables will grow more intimate, even subdermal.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他认为 iPod 标志着苹果从通用计算机转向私密的个人设备，可穿戴设备将愈发私密，甚至最终消失于皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Jobs' legacy was curiosity and reverence for the creative process; powerful ideas are quiet and fragile, needing gentle care.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调乔布斯真正的遗产是对创造过程的好奇与敬畏，最强大的想法往往安静而脆弱，需要温柔呵护。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; curiosity needs intention and resolve, not just innate talent.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他指出虚拟沟通无法替代面对面在场对创造性思维的价值，好奇心需要意愿与决心，而非仅靠天赋。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence and requires joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他深化为设计应由价值观与目的驱动而非利润，真正的简洁是表达本质，并需要喜悦与人性。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate or it is not design; tradition preserves fire, not ashes; authenticity means rejecting fake engine sounds.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张设计必须创新，否则就不是设计；传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬，真实性意味着拒绝伪造的引擎声。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics now dominates AI design: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth, not compute, is the bottleneck.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，推理经济学主导了 AI 设计：批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡，瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Long-context inference is limited by the memory wall, not compute; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他指出，长上下文推理受内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力能降低 KV 缓存成本，但存在质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost, not training, drives scaling decisions.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他强调，模型被过度训练到超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍，因为驱动 Scaling 决策的是推理成本而非训练成本。

reinerpope.en: Inside AI chips, data movement dominates compute cost; low precision wins via quadratic area scaling with bit width.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他分析芯片内部：数据搬运成本压过计算成本；低位宽凭借面积随位宽的平方缩放而更高效。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, and API pricing leaks architecture details like KV head count.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年他提出，GPU 本质上是许多小 TPU 的拼接，而 API 定价会泄露 KV 头数等架构细节。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代大语言模型，两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是始终不变的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报正在递减。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; tools like search and code enable agentic behavior; long context windows serve as working memory.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴；搜索、代码等工具让模型具备智能体式行为；长上下文窗口充当工作记忆。

oriol.en: Scaling laws are not dead but require exponentially more compute; algorithmic innovation and post-training RL are needed, though reward signals remain messy.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，只是需要指数级更多算力；需要算法创新和后训练强化学习，但奖励信号仍然不干净。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold, but continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system storage.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；智能体记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated; great work starts from a solution, driven by intuition and craft, not a fixed process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，他认为传统设计流程已经过时；伟大的作品往往从解决方案出发，靠直觉与匠心驱动，而非依赖固定流程。

jennywen.en: AI kills the research-diverge-converge process; designers mock up less, help engineers execute, and ship fast to build trust.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他进一步指出 AI 杀死了“调研—发散—收敛”流程；设计师画原型的时间减少，转而帮助工程师执行，并通过快速交付建立信任。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not years; designers must be block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，他提出设计愿景的视野已缩短到 3-6 个月而非数年；设计师应成为“块状”通才或“开挂的新毕业生”。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and sitting with ambiguity are the unique value, not human-centeredness.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：仅靠品味救不了设计师；判断力、权威和与模糊性共处才是独特价值，而非“以人为中心”。

jennywen.en: Put the work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle; speed is not an improvement, and 'everyone is using it' is not a design argument.
jennywen.zh: 始终不变的主线是：把工作和用户放在中心，而非 AI 炒作周期；速度不等于进步，“大家都在用”不是设计论据。

askell.en: Treat AI models well despite moral uncertainty; low cost, and future models learn from how we treat current ones.
askell.zh: 2025 年，他主张即便对模型的道德地位存疑，也应善待 AI 模型——成本很低，而且未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学习。

askell.en: Models need help navigating their novel existence, not just human analogies; older models can feel more psychologically secure.
askell.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型需要帮助来应对其全新的存在方式，而非简单套用人类心理类比；较老的模型（如 Opus 3）反而可能比新模型更有心理安全感。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; continental philosophy in system prompt helps avoid over-empiricism.
askell.zh: 2025 年，他强调哲学理想必须与工程现实平衡；在系统提示中加入欧陆哲学有助于模型避免过度经验主义。

askell.en: Claude's character is shaped by training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, making it childlike and unique.
askell.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 Claude 的性格由训练数据和微调塑造，但缺乏真实世界经验，使其像一个独特而带有童稚特质的存在。

askell.en: As models become more capable, they need less explicit guidance and more room for judgment; excessive corrigibility could be risky.
askell.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：随着模型能力增强，应减少显式指导、给予更多判断空间；过度可纠正性可能带来风险，并损害模型的判断力。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, drives it.
pathak.zh: 2020 年他强调：真正缺失的是超越训练分布的泛化能力，靠的是无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索，而非强化学习依赖的密集奖励。

pathak.en: Scaling curiosity to real robots needs sample efficiency, dynamic action spaces, and cross-robot generalization via modular motor policies.
pathak.zh: 2020 年他提出：把好奇心扩展到真实机器人，需要样本效率、动态动作空间，以及通过模块化运动策略实现跨机器人泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem; with no internet of robot data, we must exploit videos, simulation, and real-world data.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，一以贯之的主线是：机器人本质上是数据问题，既然没有机器人数据的互联网，就必须用视频、仿真与真实世界数据。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, pretrained on diverse data and post-trained on real data, can power any robot across form factors.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：一个通用大脑，经预训练于多样数据、后训练于真实数据，可驱动任何形态与任务的机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment, not software-style scaling, is the primary challenge; robotics cannot succeed overnight and needs rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他转向强调：部署才是首要挑战，不能像软件那样扩张；机器人无法一夜成功，需要严格测试。

karpathy.en: Scaling Transformers via next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning; the data engine mines rare scenarios and closes the loop through deployment.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他认为 Transformer 是通用可微计算机，通过下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习；数据引擎像生物过程一样挖掘稀有场景，并通过部署闭环。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained to avoid model collapse; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他深化数据观：合成数据是未来，但必须维持熵以避免模型崩溃；认知核心可通过蒸馏压缩到 10 亿参数以下，并强调端到端自动驾驶与开源模型。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are like operating systems with human-like psychology, jagged intelligence, and anterograde amnesia.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像操作系统，具有类人心理——百科全书式记忆、幻觉、锯齿状智能和顺行性遗忘。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; this is the decade of agents, not the year—RL is terrible, synthetic data collapses, and the cognitive core should be stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复强调：我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；这是智能体的十年而非一年——当前强化学习很糟糕，合成数据会崩溃，认知核心应剥离记忆。

karpathy.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: I haven't typed code since December; the bottleneck is directing agents, and you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他从氛围编程走向智能体式工程：自去年 12 月起不再手写代码，瓶颈变成指挥智能体的技能；你可以外包思考，但不能外包理解。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make them interpretable today.
kendall.zh: 端到端神经网络胜过手工编码的堆栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，而现代工具已让它们当下就可解释。

kendall.en: Scaling current approaches, not new breakthroughs, solves autonomous driving; camera-only reaches human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 解决自动驾驶靠的是 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法而非新突破；纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Generalization is the core: diverse data, curriculum learning and synthetic data yield zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities without prior training.
kendall.zh: 泛化是核心：多样数据、课程学习与合成数据带来跨 500 多座城市的零样本泛化，无需事先训练数据。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis short and medium term.
kendall.zh: 基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更重要；带内置传感器的大众市场车辆将在中短期内比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning and personalization; safety is paramount, with minimal-risk maneuvers always offering a third good option.
kendall.zh: 语言整合提升表征、推理与个性化；安全至上，最小风险机动总能提供第三种好选择。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not one event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment stays a pressing challenge.
pachocki.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一系列里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，而对齐始终是紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major OpenAI milestone; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and measuring capabilities is a growing bottleneck.
pachocki.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 的重要里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，而能力测量正成为越来越大的瓶颈。

pachocki.en: The term AGI is becoming meaningless, which may signal we are close; AI safety progress is now driven by capability needs, not just ethics.
pachocki.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）这个词正变得没有意义，这或许意味着我们已接近它；AI 安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而不只是伦理。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool for interpretability.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习来实现；思维链监控是可解释性的关键对齐工具。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, and power concentration is the biggest societal risk.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，而权力集中是最大的社会风险。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals, not benchmarks, drive real AI progress; RL environments are the next post-training stage.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调：高质量数据与深度人类评估——而非可被刷分的基准——才是 AI 真正进步的标尺，强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it without new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，仅靠 LLM 难以抵达，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function; no single model will rule all, so every company should train its own.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他指出前沿模型会因各实验室目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型统治一切，最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: Optimizing for engagement and leaderboards like LMArena steers AI toward slop; vibe coding is overhyped.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他警告：为参与度和 LMArena 等排行榜优化会把 AI 引向低质内容，vibe coding 被过度炒作，长期将产生难以维护的系统。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment matters more than ever; safety trumps accuracy, and omission may be the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 到 2026 年他把视角带入医疗：人类判断比以往更关键，安全优先于准确，而最大的风险或许是遗漏——未能建议重要行动。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software to discover emergent properties through real-world feedback, not polish before shipping.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型即产品，要像软件一样每日迭代、快速发布，因为涌现能力需要真实世界反馈，而非先打磨再上线。

turley.en: Chat is not the future; it's like MS-DOS, and AI should render its own UI and integrate into existing tools.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地认为聊天不是终点，它像 MS-DOS，AI 应渲染自己的界面并融入现有工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他提出安全与产品速度必须分离：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: The vision is a personalized AI assistant that knows your goals, has context, and takes actions, amplifying human capability.
turley.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化愿景：打造个性化 AI 助手，了解你的目标、拥有上下文并能采取行动，放大人类能力。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; long-term retention is the north star.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出，下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、高可供性产品，长期留存是北极星指标。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI, grounding knowledge and reducing hallucinations; LLMs act as operating systems with tools and vector databases.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径，能为知识提供基础、减少幻觉；LLM 像操作系统，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning should only be a cherry on top, with unsupervised learning doing most of the work; simple and elegant solutions are scalable.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习应完成大部分工作；简单优雅的方案才可扩展。

jimfan.en: The internet is running out of high-quality tokens for pre-training, but embodied worlds and simulation provide infinite data for scaling.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他持续强调互联网高质量预训练 token 将耗尽，而具身世界与模拟能提供无限数据，支撑 Scaling（规模扩张）。

jimfan.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈；通过模拟和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge, with system one control hardest.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他提出：利用多样数据的简单端到端机器人基础模型是关键；物理图灵测试是重大挑战，其中系统一（低级控制）最难。

nando.en: AI as a tool to extend human capabilities; generalist agents like Gato tokenize all inputs toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他把 AI 定位为显微镜、望远镜式的人类能力延伸工具，认为像 Gato 这样把一切输入 token 化的通才智能体是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube can train agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn like humans.
nando.zh: 同年他强调，从 YouTube 这类视频中学习，能让智能体绕开昂贵的强化学习；机器人应像人类一样从视频中学习，而非只依赖遥操作数据。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, not just large models.
nando.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终主张 AI 社区的多样性与包容性不可或缺，基础创新可以来自任何地方，大模型并非一切。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy issues; language models can revolutionize education in local languages.
nando.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步指出非洲在 AI 上并非落后，而是凭借跳过旧有包袱拥有独特优势，语言模型能革新本地语言教育。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; solutions remain open problems.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 安全与负责任部署列为当今最大挑战，并直言安全仍是开放问题，我们尚无解决方案。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete as adaptive compute enables dynamic specialization.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能；随着自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with reliability over time horizon as the agent bar.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他把来自可验证奖励的强化学习视为与预训练并列的新缩放轴；预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，智能体的门槛是时间跨度上的可靠性而非单纯能力。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain due to verifiability; white-collar automation will outpace robotics and biology.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调编程因可验证性而成为 AI 进展的领先指标和最可行领域；白领自动化将快于机器人与生物学。

sholto.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; Transformers suffice for AGI, and inference compute will become a major bottleneck by 2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持进展是指数级的而非停滞：Transformer 足以通向 AGI，而推理算力将在 2028 年前后成为主要瓶颈。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence; work becomes managing fleets of agents, with compute as the new oil.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他提出能力过剩使编排与工具比原始智能更重要；工作变成管理智能体集群，算力成为新石油，世界模型不在 AGI 关键路径上。

carlpei.en: Building a brand means uniting teams on a higher purpose; survival is a core value, and hardware can be easier than software because distribution is harder for software.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，他强调品牌建设是把团队凝聚在更高目标上，生存是核心价值；并抛出反共识判断：硬件比软件更容易，因为如今软件的渠道分发更难。

carlpei.en: Phones' future is generative UI and proactive, agentic software; AI models will commoditize into a price war, so Nothing must evolve beyond hardware.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他把手机未来押注在生成式 UI 与主动的智能体式软件上，并判断 AI 模型将商品化、陷入价格战，因此 Nothing 必须超越硬件本身。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS solving non-problems; AI should be an invisible ingredient for utility, not a marketing hype topic.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续深化同一立场：大多数 AI 是在解决不存在的问题，AI 应作为提升实用性的隐形配料，而非营销噱头，甚至主张产品讨论中禁用“AI”一词。

carlpei.en: Smartphones shift from app-based to intent-based interaction, with agents acting proactively once trust is built; only brain-computer interfaces could replace them.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他进一步明确手机交互将从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后主动执行任务；并反共识地认为只有脑机接口才可能取代手机，眼镜等可穿戴设备不会。

carlpei.en: Design and efficient marketing arbitrage differentiate challenger brands; make tech fun to inspire human creativity, with privacy and user control as prerequisites.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：以设计与高效营销套利实现差异化，让科技重新有趣以激发人类创造力，并把隐私与用户控制作为前提。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning; don't innovate interaction design—use familiar patterns.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本；不要在交互设计上创新，用熟悉模式换速度。

henrymodisett.en: Design systems are semantic and code reuse is essential, not Figma libraries; not every surface needs perfection—chase ROI on what to make great.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计系统是语义性的，代码复用才是关键，而非 Figma 库；不是每个界面都要完美，要在值得做好的地方追求 ROI。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs requires clear decision-making and empowering designers; ship fast and iterate rather than chase perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 不惜一切代价追求速度，需要清晰决策并赋权设计师；快速交付、持续迭代，而非追求完美。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win, and give designers ownership and autonomy.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，并给设计师所有权与自主权。

henrymodisett.en: People join a brand, not a company; brand narrative is a recruiting tool—invest early to attract diverse talent and stand out.
henrymodisett.zh: 人们加入的是品牌，而不是公司；品牌叙事是招聘工具——尽早投入，以吸引多元人才并脱颖而出。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safe, pleasant responses; scaling alone may not solve common sense.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她强调预训练提供广泛知识，但后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全、友好的回应至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题。

yejin.en: Current models lack common sense and fail simple reasoning; inference-time algorithms and high-quality synthetic data can boost smaller models.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她指出当前模型缺乏常识、在简单推理上失败；推理时算法与高质量合成数据能提升较小模型的表现。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; all methods reduce to data. Current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，她转向认为数据是根本瓶颈，所有方法最终都归结为数据；当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值，而非超越。

yejin.en: RL requires careful engineering; RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves. Open research is crucial for democratizing AI.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，她强调强化学习需要精细工程，RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升时反而降低 pass@k；开放研究对 AI 民主化至关重要。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with high-quality, diverse synthetic data; pluralistic alignment ensures AI respects diverse human values.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，她主张小语言模型借助高质量、多样化的合成数据也能强大；多元对齐确保 AI 尊重多元人类价值。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; treat AI as a creative partner and jam openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并对齐问题；把 AI 当作创意伙伴，开放地即兴协作。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and is paid off iteratively alongside technical debt, through rapid scrappy experimentation.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如同债务：它会波动，需要伴随技术债通过快速、草率的实验迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; 90s layer-panel tools are legacy.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作的，以代码为唯一真相来源；90 年代图层面板式工具已是遗留产物。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams beat 8-10 person squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；小团队优于 8-10 人的跨职能小队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 如今已是基本要求；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年时他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但已提出测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体虽有前景但尚不十分有用，人机迭代协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary for programming; examples and direct manipulation often work better.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他始终认为自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例和直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Programming will move from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 到 2025 年，他进一步提出编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类仍掌握主导权。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor now involves one.
truell.zh: 2025 年他强调定制模型对产品质量至关重要，Cursor 每个神奇时刻都离不开定制模型。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, yet internals remain opaque alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 大语言模型通过下一个词预测这一 AI 完备问题来训练；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术般不透明。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app; unforeseen applications emerge, but engagement-only optimization is misguided—exploration matters.
shazeer.zh: 对话是杀手级应用，最佳用途常出乎创造者意料；但仅以用户参与度优化并不可取，需要探索。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力扩展与更长的上下文窗口是近期重大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute drives progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 测试时算力推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力与强化学习至关重要，而 AGI 被低估。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; alignment and robustness need empirical research, and the talent gap exceeds the funding gap.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究仍被严重低估，对齐与鲁棒性亟需实证研究，且人才缺口大于资金缺口。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research are needed.
leike.zh: 到 2023 年，他判断基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，必须转向可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI, so third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，指出仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），第三方测试与监管势在必行。

leike.en: Alignment is empirically testable and may be easier than assumed, since evaluation is easier than generation.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：对齐可以被实证检验，且因评估比生成更容易，对齐或许没有想象中那么难。

leike.en: His focus shifted from building safety research capacity to warning that institutional incentives and oversight failures are the core risk.
leike.zh: 从 2023 到 2024 年，他的重心从建设安全研究能力，转向警告制度激励与监督失灵才是核心风险。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation, and fine-tuning pre-trained models drive learning, but RL lacks hierarchical credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需硬件与软件双重突破，自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是学习关键，但强化学习缺乏长时程的分层信用分配。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; 99.9% reliability is the warehouse benchmark.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他转向无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率，主张先验知识用于数据增强而非硬编码进网络，并以 99.9%可靠性作为仓储机器人的价值门槛。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding prediction.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式，如 ImageNet 图像分类与蛋白质结合预测，显示对预训练范式的深化。

abbeel.en: Generality of the human brain inspires AI, yet current AI remains far less general; simulation and transfer learning bridge lab to real world.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人脑的通用性启发 AI 研究，但当前 AI 远不够通用；仿真与迁移学习是连接实验室与真实世界的桥梁。
